records.title: Senior Manager, Plant Operations
records.description:
At WK Kellogg Co, we exist to create joy and connection to inspire Gr-r-reat days. We believe that doing good is always good for business and we have stood for this since Kellogg Company was founded more than 120 years ago. We are passionate about doing our part to make nutritious foods, create social connectivity and respect natural resources. Together, these actions create positive progress for people and the planet – today and for years to come. We have big plans for how we are going to accomplish this, and we would love for you to join us in this effort.
 
 
**The most compelling leadership opportunities aren’t always about stepping into something already built. Sometimes they’re about helping shape what comes next.**
The
**Senior Manager, Plant Operations**
leads the strategic and operational direction of multiple business units within a high-performing, large-scale, 24/7 manufacturing operation, and line-centric manufacturing platform.
 
 
This role drives excellence across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development by empowering Operations Managers, Supervisors, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**You won’t simply inherit an operation. You’ll have the opportunity to help build what comes next.**
**Working Relationships Include**

* Reports to: Plant Director
* Supervises: Operations Managers and Supervisors
* Peer Relationships: KSUM, Quality Manager, Sr. RM Manager, HR Manager, EHS Manager, E& F Manager, KIWS Coach
* Key Contacts: Internal – Plant Leadership Team, Corporate Operations, Engineering, KIWS, HR; External – Vendors, Contractors, and Corporate Support Functions

**Here’s What You Will Be Doing**

* Strategic Leadership: Set direction and priorities for assigned business units, ensuring alignment with plant goals and corporate strategy.
* Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Supervisor to build high-performing teams and future leaders.
* Operational Oversight: Ensure consistent execution of production plans and consistently deliver strong results across key plant KPIs, including safety, quality, food safety, cost, and service.
* Innovation & Project Execution: Lead the excellent execution of innovation and projects entering the plant, ensuring effective planning, cross-functional alignment, and successful implementation.
* Budgeting & Planning: Own the business planning and budgeting process for assigned units, including cost containment and resource allocation.
* Lean & CI Deployment: Champion and sustain lean manufacturing principles and WK Kellogg Integrated Work Systems (KIWS) across all units.
* Culture & Engagement: Drive a culture of safety, accountability, and engagement, promoting continuous learning and recognition.
* Compliance & Standards: Ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal standards related to safety, food safety, sanitation, and labor relations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with support functions and external stakeholders to optimize performance and resolve complex challenges.

**Work Environment**

* This role is based within a 24/7 union manufacturing facility.
* Must be flexible to work any shift and travel up to 25%
* Regular presence on the production floor required
* Frequent interaction with internal teams and external partners

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing
* Proven success in leading large teams and managing multiple production lines
* Strong understanding of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement systems
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others and build effective teams
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Experience in union environments preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SAP
* Experience with budget creation and performance management
* Experience working within a 24/7 manufacturing environment is preferred

***Salary Range:***

*$164,160 - $205,200*
*Salary pay ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, certifications, qualifications, relevant education or training, and local market conditions.*
*At WK Kellogg Co, our success depends on our most vital asset — our people. That’s why we’re committed to providing you with benefits and programs that support your Total Health and your journey to be and feel your best — physically, financially, emotionally, and socially.*
*Although subject to change, the below are the benefits currently offered in association with this position:*

* Incentive Plan bonus eligibility
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Savings and Investment Plan with Company match and contribution
* Paid Time Off (includes paid sick time)
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Life Insurance, AD and D Insurance and STD/LTD
* Tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance for eligible employees
* Employee recognition program

*The above offerings are subject to the terms of WKKC policies, which will control in the event of a conflict with the above descriptions*
*Our comprehensive and competitive benefits not only deliver value to you and your family, but also offer choice to meet your unique needs and knowledge to empower confident decision-making.*
**About Wk Kellogg Co**
*At WK Kellogg Co, we bring our best to everyone, every day through our trusted foods and brands. Our journey began in 1894, when our founder W.K. Kellogg reimagined the future of food with the creation of Corn Flakes, changing breakfast forever. Since then, we have embraced the same spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship in everything we do, channeling our founder’s passion and commitment to creating high quality and delicious products while fostering communities. Our iconic brand portfolio includes Frosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Froot Loops, Kashi, Special K, Raisin Bran, Frosted Mini Wheats, and Bear Naked. With a presence in the majority of households across North America, our brands play a key role in enhancing the lives of millions of consumers every day, promoting a strong sense of physical, emotional and societal wellbeing. Our beloved brand characters, including Tony the Tiger and Toucan Sam, represent our deep connections with the consumers and communities we serve. For more information, visit*

records.description:
**Senior Manager of Operations - Austin, TX**

**DESCRIPTION:**

We’re seeking a hands-on Sr. Operations Manager with experience scaling silicon-based products in a semiconductor company. This player-coach role owns the operational path from foundry and wafer production through test, backend processing, and manufacturing. You’ll qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, establish and strengthen quality-control measures, and drive consistent quality, yield, cost, and delivery as production grows.

Experience with RFID inlay production is especially relevant.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own foundry relationships from negotiation through production execution, and scale wafer level production.
* Manage wafer-test facility relationships; evaluate and qualify test partners, and select test equipment to optimize cost, quality, and throughput.
* Lead test development, wafer backend operations, yield improvement, reliability, and failure analysis.
* Qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, including overseeing end-to-end inlay production and its ramp to volume.
* Establish and improve quality-control measures, operating procedures, and RMA processes.
* Monitor supplier quality, conduct supply-chain audits, and resolve manufacturing, quality, and delivery issues.
* Establish and improve ERP/MRP processes, WIP tracking, inventory planning, and production controls.
* Develop cost models, negotiate contracts, and drive improvements in cost, quality, and delivery.
* Manage one direct report and coordinate work across four internal engineers and executive stakeholders, including the CEO.

**What you’ll bring:**

* BSEE or equivalent practical experience.
* 7–10 years of operations, manufacturing, or related experience in a semiconductor company.
* Experience with RFID inlay manufacturing is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with silicon-based products and semiconductor manufacturing operations.
* Experience scaling products from wafer fabrication and test through backend processing and volume production.
* Experience working with foundries, wafer-test facilities, and manufacturing vendors.
* Familiarity with yield optimization, reliability, quality assurance, supplier audits, failure analysis, ERP/MRP systems, WIP tracking, and inventory planning.
* Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, with a practical, roll-up-your sleeves approach.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality
records.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
 
 
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
**LOCATION**
: On-site Logan, UT.
 
 

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**
The Senior Manager, Quality for BEA and Flexible Operations at the Logan, Utah site is responsible for leading site quality operations and ensuring compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement across manufacturing processes supporting flexible single-use technologies and products. This role partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and site leadership to drive operational excellence, maintain regulatory compliance, and support business growth.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Quality will lead quality teams responsible for manufacturing quality, quality systems, and customer quality activities while fostering a strong culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
 
 
**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**
**Site Quality Leadership:**

* Lead and develop the site quality organization supporting BEA and Flexible Operations manufacturing activities.
* Establish and maintain a strong quality culture focused on compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a key member of the Logan site leadership team, contributing to strategic and operational decision-making.
* Drive accountability through quality metrics, performance management, and development planning.
* Mentor and coach quality leaders and team members to build organizational capability.

**Quality Systems:**

* Ensure site compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal quality management systems.
* Maintain site inspection readiness, including support for customer, notified body, and regulatory agency audits.
* Oversee effectiveness of Flexible site quality systems including: CAPA, Change control, Nonconformance management, Complaint handling, Document control, Training compliance, Risk management and Validation activities
* Drive timely and effective investigations, root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Support implementation and harmonization of divisional quality initiatives and procedures.

**Operational Quality Support:**

* Partner cross functionally to reduce cost of poor quality and improve operational efficiency.
* Utilize data analytics and quality metrics to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Support product transfers, capacity expansions, and new product introductions
* Ensure robust investigation practices and timely resolution of deviations and customer concerns.
* Build strong customer relationships through responsiveness, transparency, and quality performance.

**HOW YOU WILL GET HERE:**
**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Quality, or related technical discipline required
* Advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of progressive quality experience within regulated manufacturing environments
* 3+ years of leadership experience managing quality teams
* Experience in medical device, bioprocessing, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or single-use manufacturing environments preferred
* Strong knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, GMP, and FDA regulations

**Technical & Leadership Competencies:**

* Strong leadership and team development capabilities
* Proven ability to drive quality improvements in manufacturing environments
* Expertise in root cause analysis, CAPA, risk management, and quality systems
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to influence and build strong partnerships across functions
* Experience supporting audits and regulatory inspections
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Key Success Metrics:**

* Audit outcomes
* Reduction in nonconformance and quality events
* CAPA effectiveness and closure timeliness
* Customer complaint reduction and responsiveness
* Employee engagement and talent development
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction results

**Leadership Expectations:**

* Demonstrate integrity, accountability and customer focus
* Lead through collaboration, communication and empowerment
* Foster a culture of quality, safety and continuous improvement
* Operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed, global organization
* Displays the Thermo Fisher 4i values of Innovation, Integrity, Intensity and Involvement

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel up to 10% as required for business support, training and collaboration across sites

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.
 
 
Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
records.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.
 
 
For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.
 
 
At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.
 
 
We are looking for a S
**r. Manager, Quality**
to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to
**Director of Quality**
and based in
**Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week**
.
 
 
**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.
* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.
* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.
* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.
* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.
* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.
* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.
* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.
* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.
* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.
* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.
* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.
* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.
* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.
* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)
* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.
* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.
* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.
* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.
* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.
* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.
* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.
* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.
* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .
* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.
* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up
* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.
* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)
* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)
* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.
* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.
* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.
* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.
* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.
* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.
* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).
* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.
* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.
* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.
* Possess a passion for excellence.
* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.
* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.
* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.
 
 
At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.
 
 
Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.
 
 
Salary Ranges:
 
 
$149,300.00 - $214,700.00

records.description:
**Job Summary**
This Senior Manager, Quality Engineering role is a key leadership position responsible for overseeing Insulet’s global Design Transfer Quality Engineering team and ensuring new and modified Omnipod products and manufacturing processes are successfully transferred, validated, and sustained in compliance with FDA and ISO quality standards. The position leads a team of Quality Engineers supporting product launches, manufacturing expansion, process validation, risk management, CAPA, and continuous improvement initiatives across global manufacturing sites. The ideal candidate brings extensive medical device quality experience, deep expertise in design transfer, process validation, and regulatory compliance, along with proven people leadership skills. Success in this role requires partnering across Manufacturing, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality organizations to drive quality strategy, support global growth initiatives, and maintain high standards in a complex, high-volume regulated manufacturing environment.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering leads Insulet's global Design Transfer Quality Engineering team, ensuring new and changed Omnipod products and manufacturing processes are successfully transferred to production, validated and sustained in compliance with the Insulet Quality System, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485 and ISO 14971. The Sr. Quality Engineering Manager leads a team of Quality Engineers to support design transfer, capacity expansion, and process controls across Insulet's manufacturing sites. The Senior Manager establishes quality strategy, owns key QMS procedures and metrics, represents Quality throughout major design transfer and global expansion initiatives, and partners closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs and site Quality leaders. The ideal candidate is an experienced medical device quality leader who builds strong teams, makes sound risk-based decisions and drives continuous improvement in a highly regulated, high-volume manufacturing environment at a global scale.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of Quality Engineers; set priorities, manage workload and resourcing, conduct performance reviews and development plans, and lead hiring.
* Serve as Quality lead for the design transfer of new products and product design changes, ensuring quality deliverables (e.g. Project Quality Plans, Design Transfer Plans, Product Launch Plans) are created and properly executed through each phase gate.
* Serve as global process owner for Production & Process Controls and Design Transfer including procedure continuous improvement, performance monitoring of KPIs, and development of new or expanded processes to support Insulet’s growing production capacity.
* Support manufacturing process validation, equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and Test Method Validation for new manufacturing lines, capacity expansion, site transfers and equipment upgrades; review and approve plans, protocols and reports.
* Drive process risk management across all sites, including pFMEA governance and integration of nonconformance and production data into risk management.
* Lead remediation and compliance initiatives and provide Quality oversight of CAPAs, investigations, quality events and nonconformances, ensuring effective root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.
* Partner with global manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers to deploy harmonized quality and process improvements.
* Provide Quality leadership for enterprise systems and digital initiatives (e.g. SAP, MES, eDHR, eQMS).
* Prepare and present quality metrics and project status for operations leadership, QMS process owner forums, and management review.
* Support internal and external audits as a subject matter expert, maintain inspection readiness, and serve as the escalation point for cross-functional quality questions from Operations, Engineering and Supply Chain.

**Education And Experience**

* BS degree in engineering, a technical or scientific discipline; and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Master's degree in engineering or technical or scientific discipline preferred.
* Minimum 10 years' experience in Medical Device Quality Assurance.
* 3-5 years' experience managing people, including leading engineers and technical staff.
* In-depth knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485 and ISO 14971.
* Demonstrated experience leading design transfer and process validation for high-volume manufacturing of single-use products, preferably on automated manufacturing equipment.
* Experience with process risk management (pFMEA), CAPA, nonconformance and change control processes; QMS process ownership experience preferred.
* Experience with statistical methods (e.g. statistical process control, sampling plans, Test Method Validation, gauge R&R, and capability).
* Experience working with global manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers.
* Experience with eQMS/PLM, ERP and data visualization tools, as well as word processing, spreadsheet and database programs.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Proven ability to build, lead and develop high-performing teams, including effective delegation and succession planning.
* Strategic thinking with the ability to organize, judge and balance priorities across multiple complex projects.
* Sound, risk-based decision making in a highly regulated environment.
* Strong verbal (including presentation) and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and present to executive leadership.
* Effective collaboration and communication with individuals at multiple levels and across functions, sites and geographies.
* Strong problem solving / root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to generate and maintain organized and accurate records, and to follow up with task owners to close out open items.

**Other Expectations**

* Flexibility to work across multiple time zones, outside of normal working hours.
* Travel (International) – 10%

*NOTE: This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements (requires on-site work from an Insulet office).*
**Additional Information**
Compensation & Benefits: For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $138,700.00 - $208,000.00 This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
 
 

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* And additional employee wellness programs Application Details: This job posting will remain open until the position is filled. To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online. Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.
 
 
We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!
 
 
At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
 
 
(Know Your Rights)

records.title: Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer, General Assembly & Test, Optimus

postedPay.title: Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer, General Assembly & Test, Optimus

records.description:
**What To Expect**
Tesla is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer to build and lead a team of engineers focused on high-volume production launches. This role will drive the development of scalable manufacturing systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product designs for manufacturability, accelerate assembly processes, and implement automation solutions. In this fast-paced, demanding environment, you’ll play a pivotal role in scaling Tesla’s SI robotics initiatives while advancing our mission to achieve sustainable abundance through innovative manufacturing practices.
 
 
**What You'll Do**- Lead Manufacturing Engineering Team: Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams to design and deploy high-volume production systems, ensuring alignment with Tesla’s speed and quality objectives
- Collaborate with Equipment Suppliers: Partner with internal and external suppliers to engineer, install, and validate production equipment, accelerating line ramp-up to meet volume targets
- Validate Requirements and Constraints: Use first principles analysis to rigorously assess product and process requirements, eliminating ambiguity and ensuring all elements are purpose-driven and essential
- Optimize Production Processes: Identify and remove non-value-added steps in workflows, prioritizing functional simplicity before pursuing automation or advanced optimization
- Improve Cycle Time: Analyze production bottlenecks and implement solutions to increase process speed, throughput, and overall line efficiency
- Deploy Automation Solutions: Strategically integrate automation as a final step after process simplification, ensuring systems are robust, high-speed, and scalable
- Ensure Seamless Operational Transitions: Coordinate with operations teams during ramp-up phases, delivering detailed documentation and training to sustain engineering teams for long-term success
**What You'll Bring**- First Principles Thinking: A rigorous mindset focused on breaking down complex problems to their fundamental truths, enabling innovative solutions to manufacturing challenges
- Proficiency in CAD tools (Catia and AutoCAD preferred) for designing and optimizing production systems
- Deep knowledge of mechanical assembly techniques (pressing, fastening, harnessing, etc.) and electrical integration, including quality control matrices, testing protocols, and troubleshooting methodologies
- Familiarity with torque tools, automation equipment, control systems, and communication protocols (e.g., PLC, HMI, SCADA)
- Production Transition Experience: Demonstrated success in scaling products from prototype to high-volume production, ensuring seamless handover to sustaining teams
- Resilience & Adaptability: Ability to thrive in high-pressure environments while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines
- Communication & Organization: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, paired with meticulous attention to detail and a highly organized approach to documentation and process handover
- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical or Electrical engineering, or equivalent experience
**Benefits**
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
 
- Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
- Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
- Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
- Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
- Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
- Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
- Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
- Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
- Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
- Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
- Tesla Babies program
- Commuter benefits
- Employee discounts and perks program
- Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
Expected Compensation
 
 
$156,000 - $276,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits
 
 
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
 
 
, Tesla

records.title: Director of Product Development & Industrialization
records.description:
At Horizon Hobby, we inspire dreams and help build memories! Our company is the leader in the global Radio Control industry, celebrating 40 years in 2025! We offer tremendous opportunities for growth and development and a full array of benefits including discounts on our products! We are currently hiring for a Director of Product Development and Industrialization at our Pro-Line office in Banning CA!
 
 
*This is a full time, on-site position at our Pro-Line facility in Banning California. Workings hours will be Monday-Friday 8am-5pm PST.*
**Typical pay for this position is $105,000-$125,000. The final offer for this position will be based on the unique experience and qualifications of the candidate selected. This position may also be eligible for a bonus not included in the base pay range.**
The Director of Product Development & Industrialization will provide strategic leadership for the development, commercialization, and industrialization of proprietary hobby products from concept through production. This role will be leading our Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization resources while overseeing the systems, processes, tooling, molds, manufacturing equipment, and technical capabilities required to deliver innovative, high-quality products to market.
 
 
This role will partner closely with Brand, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Tooling, and external partners to identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into successful products, and ensure products are designed, developed, and launched efficiently. The role balances technical excellence with business performance, ensuring product investments align with growth objectives, customer demand, profitability targets, and long-term strategic priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Innovation & Strategy
 
 

* Partner with Brand and cross-functional teams to define product roadmaps, priorities, resources, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and development investments that strengthen market position, customer satisfaction, growth, and return on investment.
* Identify and prioritize new product opportunities using customer insight, competitive analysis, market trends, and commercial potential.

Product Development Leadership
 
 

* Lead and develop Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization teams supporting proprietary products.
* Own product development from concept and engineering through validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Strengthen quality, scalability, execution, and organizational capability through standards, coaching, succession planning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Business & Commercial Leadership
 
 

* Monitor portfolio performance and align cross-functional priorities to achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Contribute to portfolio planning, market expansion, long-range growth, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Provide senior leadership with business reviews, development updates, performance metrics, and recommendations.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness
 
 

* Lead new-product industrialization from concept through launch, applying DFM and DFA to optimize quality, scalability, cost, and manufacturing readiness.
* Partner across Engineering, Manufacturing, Tool Room, suppliers, and development teams to resolve challenges and improve processes, tooling, and capacity.
* Track launch, readiness, quality, and productivity performance to drive continuous improvement.

Tooling, Equipment & Technology
 
 

* Define requirements and roadmaps for molds, tooling, fixtures, machinery, automation, and manufacturing technology.
* Lead capital planning and business cases that improve capability, productivity, quality, cost, and return on investment.
* Manage external tooling and manufacturing partners, strengthen internal capabilities, and maintain effective engineering data and technical documentation processes.

Supplier & Partner Management
 
 

* Build strategic relationships with domestic and international manufacturing, tooling, engineering, and supplier partners.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance to improve quality, speed, cost competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.

*Success in this role requires strong leadership across innovation, engineering, manufacturing, and business functions to continuously improve speed to market, product quality, operational performance, and return on investment*
**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product management, category management, business management, product development, or a related leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Demonstrated success growing a product category, business unit, or consumer product portfolio.
* Experience developing and launching successful products from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, business cases, and profitability.
* Proven ability to develop business strategies and translate them into measurable results.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to travel as required for customer visits, product testing, trade shows, industry events, and supplier meetings.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the RC, hobby products, powersports, automotive aftermarket, consumer products, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with enthusiast communities, racers, influencers, or brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, new product introduction, and global sourcing environments.
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) and project management systems.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional lifting of office supplies and materials, up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on a computer.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.*
**Benefits & Other Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* HSA and FSA options
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance and Supplemental Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Internal Rewards
* Discounts on Products
* Additional Coverage such as accident, critical, hospital and pet insurance

*Horizon Hobby is a progressive, innovative company and, as such, is constantly reevaluating and reinventing the processes and procedures associated with each job. The essential duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time. In addition, employees may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work necessary or important to the operation of Horizon. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected and appreciated.*
**Horizon Hobby, LLC is an equal opportunity and E-Verify employer**

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 
**Director, Operational Excellence**
We're advancing cancer care through innovative screening and diagnostic tests that help patients and healthcare providers make informed decisions before, during and after a cancer diagnosis. Our growing portfolio includes Cologuard®, Oncotype DX®, Cancerguard® and Oncodetect®, along with advanced genetic testing, supporting patients from cancer prevention and early detection through personalized treatment decisions and recurrence monitoring. We're focused on helping more people take action against cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages, so they can live longer, healthier lives.
 
 
This role is based on-site in Madison, WI.
 
 
**Position Overview**
Abbott is seeking a Director, Operational Excellence to lead the development, implementation, and sustainability of operational excellence practices across our Cancer Diagnostics operations.
 
 
This leader will partner closely with operations leadership and frontline teams to strengthen daily management practices, improve operational performance, and build a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead the implementation of operational excellence practices that improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and sustain tiered management routines, visual performance boards, standardized metrics, and structured performance reviews across hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
* Partner with operations leaders to implement supervisor standard work, strengthen accountability, and develop consistent problem-solving and performance management practices.
* Apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve process flow, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and drive measurable operational results.
* Establish employee-driven improvement programs that encourage frontline participation, idea generation, and ownership of operational improvements.
* Lead change management efforts that ensure new processes are adopted, embedded into daily operations, and sustained over time.
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to align improvement initiatives with business priorities.
* Lead and coach a team of operational excellence professionals while building continuous improvement capabilities across the broader organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree in a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
* Significant progressive experience in operations leadership, operational excellence, or continuous improvement within a manufacturing, laboratory, or complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and sustaining Lean practices, daily management systems, visual performance management, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience leading operational teams or working directly with frontline leaders to drive measurable performance improvements.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build accountability.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct leadership experience in manufacturing, laboratory, or other high-volume operations.
* Experience in regulated industries such as diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience implementing tiered management systems, supervisor standard work, and employee-driven continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated success sustaining operational improvements through frontline engagement and leadership ownership.

The base pay for this position is $149,300.00 – $298,700.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

records.title: Director of Operational Excellence
records.description:
Pay Range:$65.73 - $92.22 Job Profile Summary: The Director of Operational Excellence leads SEARHC’s improvement function, translating annual operating plan priorities into measurable, sustainable operational results. Reporting directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence, the Director supervises Associate Program Managers, Program Managers, and Senior Program Managers, develops improvement and change capabilities, balances team assignments and capacity, and oversees delivery quality and benefits measurement. This hands-on leader personally leads selected complex transformations and partners with executive sponsors and operational owners to diagnose problems, redesign processes, implement change, and sustain results. The Senior Program Manager level expands advanced program leadership capacity while the Director remains accountable for the function and continues direct involvement in transformational projects. The Director works with the PMO through one integrated portfolio and common reporting approach. The System Director retains enterprise direction and executive alignment; operational sponsors retain accountability for operational decisions, resources, and sustained performance.
 
 
SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.
 
 
Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.
 
 
**Key Essential Functions And Accountabilities Of The Job**

* Leads the Operational Excellence team and translates approved annual operating plan priorities into a coordinated improvement work plan; personally leads selected highly complex efforts while maintaining capacity for staff leadership and development.
* Integrates related improvement work across functions and operational owners; develops coherent transformation approaches, resolves cross-workstream dependencies, and coordinates supporting projects with the PMO through shared portfolio processes.
* Advises sponsors on competing approaches, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs; facilitates difficult cross-functional decisions and escalates resource and priority decisions through established governance without assuming executive approval authority.
* Synthesizes complex operational, quality, service, and financial information with specialist partners; establishes credible baselines and benefits measures, examines performance variation, and evaluates outcomes, unintended effects, and sustained benefits.
* Assigns improvement work, balances team capacity, and oversees plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery quality within approved priorities and resources; partners with the PMO on common reporting and escalates capacity and priority tradeoffs to the System Director.
* Leads change-impact assessment, stakeholder alignment, readiness, and adoption planning for complex transformations; partners on communication and training and verifies that new practices are used across affected operations.
* Leads advanced performance diagnosis, workflow and operating-model redesign, structured testing, and implementation; establishes standard work, measurement ownership, review routines, and transition plans with operational owners to sustain results.
* Develops executive-level updates, governance materials, and strategic implementation reporting for leaders and decision-making bodies.
* Supervises, coaches, and develops improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels; establishes role-appropriate performance expectations, evaluates performance, supports recruitment and onboarding, and builds reusable improvement and change methods to strengthen team capability and consistency.
* Demonstrates SEARHC’s values and supports work that advances the organization’s mission, vision, strategic plan, and operating plan.
* Other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities
 
 
This position reports directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence and directly supervises improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels. Responsibilities include staff performance management, coaching and development, assignments, workload balancing, and delivery oversight in accordance with organizational policies. Senior Program Managers provide technical coaching and program leadership; the Director retains personnel and assignment authority across all levels. The System Director retains enterprise direction, executive alignment, and escalation of enterprise priority and resource decisions.
 
 
**Additional Details**
**Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, or a related field
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare, operational improvement, program management, or project management experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
* Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field preferred
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, change management, or similar improvement methodology training/certification preferred

**Experience Required**

* Six to eight or more years of experience in healthcare operations, program management, project management, quality improvement, or operational improvement, including independent leadership of complex, ambiguous, enterprise-wide improvement programs with measurable and sustained results
* Experience advising executive sponsors, integrating changes across multiple operational owners, facilitating consequential cross-functional decisions, and supervising and developing professional staff
* Demonstrated advanced expertise in performance diagnosis, process redesign, change adoption, benefits measurement, and sustainment across complex healthcare operations, with experience managing staff performance, assignments, and workload

**Knowledge of**

* Healthcare operations, workflow design, and advanced performance improvement principles
* Advanced improvement methods, including process mapping, root cause analysis, structured testing, performance variation, operating-model redesign, and outcome, process, and balancing measures
* Project and program management practices, including planning, tracking, risk management, issue escalation, and cross-functional integration across large or interdependent initiatives
* Data analysis, reporting, and use of healthcare operational and performance metrics to support executive decision-making
* Advanced change-impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, readiness and adoption measurement, capability building, standard work, sustainment, and shared governance principles
* Regulatory, accreditation, and compliance considerations that affect healthcare operations and process redesign
* Staff supervision, performance management, professional development, workload planning, and improvement practice management

Skills in
 
 

* Building effective working relationships with leaders, providers, staff, and cross-functional teams, including senior leaders, governance participants, and executive stakeholders
* Facilitating complex meetings, work sessions, governance discussions, decision-making, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders
* Using standard business software and healthcare information systems to organize work, analyze information, and communicate effectively
* Communicating clearly and effectively in written, verbal, presentation, and executive reporting formats
* Coaching and developing improvement professionals, setting clear expectations, balancing assignments, and providing constructive performance feedback

Ability to
 
 

* Facilitate complex problem-solving, support conflict resolution, and help remove high-level operational barriers to execution across enterprise or highly interdependent initiatives
* Influence without direct authority, foster collaboration, and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, tradeoffs, and execution plans
* Analyze complex issues, develop practical recommendations, and support implementation of operational change across multiple functions or enterprise priorities
* Work effectively with people from diverse disciplines, backgrounds, and perspectives
* Adapt to changing organizational priorities, healthcare environments, and operational demands while maintaining momentum across complex initiatives

**Position Information**
Work Shift:Exempt
 
 
*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

records.title: Director - Corporate Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Description**
****Position Summary****
The Director of Corporate Continuous Improvement (CI) leads MacAllister’s enterprise CI strategy, Corporate CI team, and improvement portfolio. In partnership with the owner, executive team, and divisional leaders, the Director helps establish and build alignment around MacAllister’s CI vision, strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap. The Director identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, builds organizational problem-solving capability, and leads improvement work from opportunity identification through execution and sustainment.
 
 
The role establishes CI standards, tools, and training; coaches, mentors, and influences leaders and teams across the organization; and communicates CI priorities, results, and opportunities for support.
 
 
The ultimate objective is to build and sustain a culture in which continuous improvement becomes habitual and is reflected in how leaders and employees think, act, solve problems, and improve the way work gets done.
 
 
****Position Duties/Responsibilities****
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Partner with the executive team, and divisional leaders to develop and maintain MacAllister’s CI strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and operating model aligned with company goals. Build leadership alignment and shared ownership of CI priorities and expectations across the organization.
* Own CI project identification, prioritization, approval, execution, and close-out, focusing on where CI creates the most value; support employee-driven improvement alongside leader-sponsored initiatives.
* Maintain consistent project close-out documenting results, lessons learned, and sustainment plans; verify improvements and results are sustained and take corrective action as needed.
* Set organization-wide CI standards, tools, and terminology; guide Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA application grounded in facts, data, and root cause analysis; coach project teams and facilitate select high-impact improvement events.
* Lead improvement-related change management, engaging affected employees early and ensuring process adoption and sustainment.
* Oversee CI training tailored to responsibility levels using consistent terminology and live projects; coach and support CI-trained departmental leaders who remain in their home departments outside CI.
* Define CI value primarily through capability measures—leaders solving problems independently, AI use cases adopted, and idea-to-approval cycle time—with financial results as supporting evidence.
* Communicate CI initiatives, results, and available support so leaders know when and how to engage the team; share success stories and recognize improvement contributors.
* Use coaching-first leadership to build team autonomy, confidence, and influence; foster problem reporting, experimentation, and learning from mistakes by supporting people publicly and coaching privately.
* Hire, develop, and manage CI personnel; oversee budget, resource allocation, and team structure as needs evolve.
* Play a leadership role in MacAllister’s Center of Practice for CI, AI, and problem-solving leadership, incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into CI methods where they improve problem solving, decision making, or productivity. Partner with MacAllister’s enterprise AI leadership on broader AI strategy, standards, and adoption.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly supervises the Corporate CI team and oversees day-to-day operations of the CI department. Mentors and coaches CI team members to strengthen their capabilities as problem solvers, facilitators, coaches, and trusted business partners.
* Reviews and evaluates the work and performance of reporting employees; has authority for hiring and disciplinary actions.

****Position Requirements****
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years or more of experience in continuous improvement, operations, or business transformation.
* 5 years or more of experience leading leaders.
* Proven success coaching others to identify and solve problems independently.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA.
* A valid driver’s license.

**Preferred**

* Master’s degree in business or a related discipline.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt or equivalent depth of experience designing and delivering CI training.
* Experience at a Caterpillar dealership or in the equipment sales, service, or rental industry.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen problem solving, process improvement, decision support, and organizational productivity. Experience applying AI in these areas is preferred but not required.
* Experience building on an existing CI function and growing its influence across a multi-location organization.

****Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities****

* Strong coaching and leadership development skills; leads through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to connect improvement work to business priorities and help leaders choose where to focus.
* Curiosity about and practical comfort with AI as a business tool.
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills with all levels, from the front line to executives.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with executives, senior managers, and teams.
* Respect for existing culture and relationships, with the judgment to improve without unnecessary disruption.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
* Effective computer skills with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn proprietary systems.

****Other Requirements of Position****

* Works under broad supervision. Designs and carries out programs and far-reaching objectives independently, informing management as appropriate.
* Major responsibilities require a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
* If an error is made while in this position, it will require some effort to identify and can significantly impact the company financially.
* Frequently communicates with coworkers, customers, company executives, and management.
* Maintain equipment and supplies to avoid waste, damage to areas and equipment, and to prevent accidents.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this posting are not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs.
 
 
All MacAllister Machinery companies are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, including Disabled and Veteran applicants.

records.title: Managing Director, Enterprise Quality
records.description:
We are hiring a Managing Director, Enterprise Quality to join our Enterprise Risk Adjustment, Quality & Affordability team at BCBST!

In this role, reporting to the VP of Enterprise Risk Adjustment, Quality and Affordability, you will provide enterprise leadership and strategic direction for Quality ratings, with accountability for establishing and executing the enterprise Quality strategy and driving measurable performance across key programs and outcomes. You will lead and integrate quality efforts across Medicare, Commercial and Medicaid products, including MA Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, clinical quality, pharmacy, member experience, provider performance, data and analytics. You’ll establish clear governance and accountability, evaluate performance and the effectiveness of interventions, and partner across the organization to remove barriers, align priorities, and drive sustained improvement in enterprise Quality performance.

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring significant healthcare quality leadership experience and a track record of leading at the enterprise level. You’ll be a strong candidate if you have led complex Quality functions and are comfortable operating in a highly visible leadership role that requires influence across multiple areas of the organization.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own and direct the enterprise Quality strategy, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations across lines of business and key Quality domains, including Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, Appeals, clinical quality, member experience, provider performance, and other priority Quality areas.
* Establish and lead enterprise Quality governance and performance management, ensuring clear accountability among Quality leaders, Measure Champions, and cross-functional stakeholders for achievement of established goals and performance outcomes.
* Monitor enterprise Quality performance and intervention effectiveness, using data and analytics to identify emerging risks, performance gaps, and opportunities; ensure interventions are achieving required results and drive timely corrective action and escalation when performance is off track.
* Lead and integrate Quality efforts across the enterprise, partnering with Clinical Operations, Pharmacy, Provider and Network organizations, Customer Service, Member Experience and Outreach, Risk Adjustment, IT/Data, and other functions to align priorities, resolve cross-functional barriers, and coordinate Quality activities that extend beyond the formal Quality organization.
* Provide strategic oversight for clinical and service quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and accreditation, ensuring Quality programs and practices align with applicable CMS, NCQA, URAC, and other regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Direct enterprise strategies to improve provider Quality performance, including collaboration on provider engagement, value-based care, performance improvement, incentive programs, and other initiatives designed to improve clinical and Quality outcomes.
* Lead, develop, and align Quality leaders and teams, establishing clear expectations and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring the organization has the appropriate expertise, resources, and capabilities to achieve Quality objectives.
* Serve as a leader and advocate for Quality, communicating performance, risks, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and other key stakeholders and influencing decisions necessary to advance enterprise Quality outcomes.

**Job Qualifications**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, health sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, required. Equivalent experience is defined as four years of professional work experience in a corporate or healthcare environment.

Experience

* 10 years - Experience in healthcare, health insurance, Quality, performance improvement, or a related field required.
* 5 years - Progressive leadership experience, including responsibility for leading leaders and/or complex, cross-functional teams required.
* Significant experience leading healthcare Quality strategy, performance improvement, or Quality management programs required.
* Experience with healthcare Quality measurement and performance programs, including Medicare Advantage, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, or similar programs required.

Skills/Certifications

* Extensive knowledge of healthcare Quality measurement, performance improvement, and industry practices, including Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, clinical quality, and provider performance.
* Strong knowledge of applicable healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements, including CMS, NCQA, and URAC.
* Strong strategic planning, analytical, and performance management skills with the ability to translate complex data and performance trends into actionable strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to establish accountability and drive results across complex, cross-functional environments, including areas outside of direct reporting authority.

**Number of Openings Available**

1

**Worker Type:**

Employee

**Company:**

BCBST BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee, Inc.

**Applying for this job indicates your acknowledgement and understanding of the following statements:**

BCBST will recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, veteran status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Further information regarding BCBST's EEO Policies/Notices may be found by reviewing the following page:

BCBST's EEO Policies/Notices

**BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee via-email, the Internet or any other method without a valid, written Direct Placement Agreement in place for this position from BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee HR/Talent Acquisition will not be considered. No fee will be paid in the event the applicant is hired by BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee as a result of the referral or through other means.**

records.title: Director, Central Quality Audit, Pharmacovigilance
records.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Managing, ensuring and improving capabilities to comply with external standards and regulations. Interprets internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may influence work. 
 
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the Pharmacovigilance (PV) Audit Program: Develop, implement, and maintain the global PV audit strategy, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations (e.g., EMA, FDA, MHRA, PMDA) and industry best practices.
* Manage Audit Operations: Oversee scheduling, planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up for PV audits, including internal audits and audits of service providers and affiliates. Fully participate in the audit program; actively owning and executing PV audits.
* Risk Identification and Communication: Identify high-risk compliance issues, escalate findings, and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.
* Regulatory Inspection Support: Prepare for and support PV-related health authority inspections, including back-room management and post-inspection follow-up.
* Metrics and Reporting: Define and track PV audit KPIs, ensuring visibility of compliance risks and trends to leadership.
* System Ownership: Manage audit-related modules within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including support of configuration, UAT, and documentation.
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of 3–5 auditors, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PV Operations, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure audit outcomes drive continuous improvement.
* Strategic Influence: Contribute to policy development and influence PV compliance strategy across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.
* Qualified Lead Auditor with active certification.
* Master’s degree and 5+ years in pharmacovigilance or pharmaceutical industry; or Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience driving Global programs to resolve quality compliance issues (directly).
* Experience with Pharmaceutical QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to cGMP, GDP, GPvP, GCP and GLP.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience with Medical Device QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to FDA CFR 21 820 and ISO 13485.
* Prior Veeva and TrackWise Digital experience a plus.
* Prior health authority experience a plus.
* IRCA, ASQ (CQE, CQA, etc.) and/or Lean Certification a plus (green belt, black belt).
* Extensive experience in the Medica Device and Pharmaceutical industry.
* Understanding of product quality improvement using tools such as Six Sigma, DFR.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
* Exceptional conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to interface with top organizational leadership and internal and external customers, responding in a professional manner.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to prioritize and drive multiple programs.
* Ability to energize others by building a connection with the team through personal involvement and trust, providing feedback and coaching to develop others, and accountability of actions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
* Integrity: Accepting and adhering to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, actions, and when dealing with others.
* Ability to travel globally up to 15%.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $142,400.00-$213,600.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

**Additional Information**
==========================

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

Application Deadline: December 21, 2026
