records.title: Director of Signage Production
records.description:
The Production Director leads all signage manufacturing operations, including fabrication, wide-format printing, finishing, assembly, production quality and installation. This leader is accountable for meeting customer commitments, maximizing production capacity, controlling costs, and achieving departmental financial objectives. 
This is a high-accountability leadership role requiring operational expertise, financial discipline, and a growth mindset. The Director will build a high-performing team, establish clear expectations, improve productivity, eliminate bottlenecks, and ensure the department can scale efficiently as Strategic Factory grows. 
The objective is to deliver exceptional quality, flawless execution, and profitable growth through strong leadership, disciplined processes, and measurable results. 
Essential Responsibilities1. Financial Performance and Profitability

* Own departmental performance against revenue, gross margin, labor, material, and profitability targets.
* Monitor job costing, estimated versus actual labor, material usage, overtime, waste, and rework to protect margins.
* Establish cost controls and identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce expenses, and increase throughput.
* Align staffing, equipment, purchasing, and production capacity with work orders, forecasts, and company growth objectives.
* Partner with the VP of Signage, Finance, Sales, and Project Management to ensure production decisions support company-wide financial goals.

2. Production Leadership and Execution

* Lead all daily signage production operations, including fabricated signs, channel letters, dimensional signage, wide-format printing, finishing, and assembly.
* Own production scheduling, workflow, capacity planning, and on-time completion.
* Establish clear priorities, deadlines, and ownership across production teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, and Installation to ensure projects move efficiently from order to completion.
* Identify constraints early, resolve production issues quickly, and maintain visibility into work in progress, material availability, and equipment utilization.
* Ensure production commitments are realistic, communicated, and consistently achieved.

3. Leadership and Accountability

* Build and develop a high-performing team focused on urgency, quality, teamwork, and results.
* Establish clear roles, measurable expectations, and accountability for supervisors and production employees.
* Hold team leaders accountable for schedules, staffing, productivity, quality, safety, and financial performance.
* Coach and develop supervisors to solve problems, make decisions, and own their results rather than relying on constant intervention.
* Address performance issues promptly, recognize strong performance, and ensure appropriate training and staffing.
* Foster a positive, high-energy culture that values continuous improvement, direct communication, and follow-through.
* Leadership standard: Set expectations, provide the tools to succeed, measure results, coach consistently, and hold people accountable.

4. Quality and Customer Satisfaction

* Establish quality standards for all fabricated, printed, and finished signage.
* Ensure work meets approved artwork, engineering specifications, material requirements, and customer expectations.
* Track defects, rework, scrap, and customer complaints; implement corrective actions to prevent recurring problems.
* Partner with Project Management and Installation to resolve issues and protect customer commitments.
* Promote a customer-first mindset in which quality, communication, and on-time delivery drive retention and future revenue.

5. Operational Excellence and Growth

* Continuously improve workflows, production methods, standard operating procedures, and equipment utilization.
* Eliminate bottlenecks, unnecessary handling, downtime, waste, and inefficient labor practices.
* Develop a scalable production plan aligned with sales forecasts and annual revenue goals.
* Identify staffing, equipment, facility, and technology investments needed to support growth, with clear financial justification.
* Make disciplined in-house versus outsourcing decisions based on cost, capacity, quality, and delivery.
* Use production data and performance scorecards to identify trends, assign corrective actions, and measure results.

6. Materials, Equipment, and Safety

* Manage material planning, inventory accuracy, purchasing coordination, and supplier performance.
* Control material waste and ensure supplies are available to meet production schedules without unnecessary inventory.
* Oversee preventive maintenance and ensure equipment is operated and maintained properly.
* Maintain a safe, organized production environment and enforce company safety policies and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Ensure required training, maintenance records, and safety procedures are consistently maintained.

7. Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

* Provide regular reporting on financial performance, production schedules, capacity, staffing, quality, and operational risks.
* Communicate schedule changes, material shortages, and customer delivery risks proactively.
* Work collaboratively with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, and Installation to achieve company objectives.
* Support leadership decisions, communicate priorities consistently, and focus on solutions rather than excuses.

The Director will be evaluated against established company targets, including:

* Financial: Revenue achievement, gross margin, labor costs, and departmental profitability.
* Execution: On-time delivery, schedule adherence, throughput, and production cycle time.
* Quality: Rework, scrap, defects, and customer complaints.
* Productivity: Labor efficiency, overtime, equipment utilization, and capacity.
* Growth: Ability to increase production volume while controlling costs and maintaining quality.
* Leadership: Staffing, employee development, accountability, and performance improvement.
* Operational discipline: Material waste, inventory accuracy, safety, and completion of improvement initiatives.
 
* **Requirements**

 

* 7-10 years of progressive experience in sign manufacturing, fabrication, wide-format printing, or a related production environment.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing production teams and preferably multiple production functions.
* Demonstrated experience with fabricated and printed signage, production scheduling, workflow management, and quality control.
* Proven ability to manage job costs, labor, materials, capacity, and profitability.
* Track record of improving productivity, quality, on-time delivery, and financial results.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with ERP/MIS systems, production reporting, and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of equipment maintenance, workplace safety, and manufacturing best practices.
* Relevant degree preferred; equivalent experience and demonstrated results will be considered.

records.title: Head of Production, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement

postedPay.title: Head of Production, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement

records.description:
At Alloy Precision Technologies, we unite advanced manufacturing with hands-on mastery to deliver for our customers—and create meaningful growth for our people. Lead the engine room of our business and amplify impact across operations.

**Your mission**
----------------

* Own the production, supply chain, maintenance, planning, and warehouse ecosystem—drive flow, reliability, and cost discipline.
* Build systems that make performance visible: schedule adherence, on-time delivery, throughput, and quality.
* Elevate safety and environmental performance through visible leadership and clear standards.
* Institutionalize lean practices and business process improvements that reduce waste and improve profitability.
* Publish clear, actionable reports that inform decisions across the organization.
* Set annual targets and programs for manufacturing, service, and distribution that align with strategy.
* Ensure outcomes meet customer expectations and comply with AS9100 and applicable regulations.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required to support operations and partner engagements.
* Take on additional priorities as assigned by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Plan, coordinate, and control day-to-day operations across all manufacturing services.
* Diagnose and resolve production delays and constraints via structured problem solving.
* Strengthen cross-functional communication to align objectives and remove friction.
* Coach and mentor leaders; cultivate a culture of empowerment, accountability, and teamwork.

**Team leadership**
-------------------

* Directly lead group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; adapt org structure as needs evolve.
* Execute people processes in accordance with APT policies and all applicable laws: hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, recognition, discipline, issue resolution, and career growth.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years in manufacturing management; exposure to precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is beneficial.
* Advanced skills with Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and establishing labor standards for cost models is advantageous.
* High-energy, results-driven leadership with exceptional interpersonal skills; able to influence at every level.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
* Flexible, resilient, and growth-oriented within an evolving culture; dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated lean manufacturing capability required; Six Sigma background is a plus.

records.title: Plant Manager- Manufacturing
records.description:
**Company Overview** 
Globe Products Co., Inc. is a leading manufacturer specializing in hose ferrules, eyelets, and metal stampings. Since 1981, we have been committed to delivering high-quality metal components to customers across various industries, emphasizing innovation and excellence in every product.

**Job Summary** 
The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day-to-day operations of the facility, with full accountability for Production, Plating, Tool Room, Machine Shop, Maintenance, and all Processing functions. This position ensures all departments operate in alignment to efficiency, accountability, and on-time delivery while supporting Globe’s quality system, EOS framework, and continuous improvement culture.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership & Team Development

· Lead, mentor, and hold accountable supervisors, foremen, and plant personnel across all operations (Production, Plating, Tool Room, Machine Shop, Maintenance, Processing).

· Set clear expectations and drive performance through consistent follow-up and accountability.

· Foster a culture of safety, urgency, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

· Ensure strong coordination between departments to meet production schedules and shipping requirements.

· Review daily operational results, identifying gaps in performance, efficiency, setup, and downtime, and drive improvements.

· Support new production runs to ensure smooth execution.

· Reinforce EOS disciplines, including Rocks, Scorecards, To-Dos, and Level 10 meetings.

**Maintenance & Facility Management**

· Production equipment and machinery

· Tooling and machining equipment

· Plating lines, processing systems, and waste treatment

· Facility / building system repairs or installs (electrical, HVAC, air, water, structural)

· Contractor / outside vendor coordination

· Lead maintenance team activities and ensure proper resource allocation.

· Maintain spare parts inventory and maintenance database.

· Preventive and predictive maintenance programs

· Maintenance tracking and documentation

· Equipment uptime, reliability, and reduction in unplanned downtime

· Immediate response and resolution of equipment failures

**Production and Processing Management**

· Lead and hold Production and Process Supervisors accountable for meeting customer and shipping requirements.

· Ensure effective planning across production, plating, and processing operations.

· Ensure accuracy and completion of all process documentation and reporting.

**Tooling, Machine Shop & Inventory Control**

· Lead and hold the Tool Room and Machine Shop accountable for performance, workflow, and tooling readiness.

· Ensure timely delivery of tooling to production and maintain tooling quality standards.

· Oversee tooling inventory, storage, and accuracy.

· Manage machining operations (lathes, mills, and related equipment).

· Drive continuous improvement in tooling performance and availability.

**Qualifications**

· Proven leadership experience in a manufacturing environment (5+ years preferred)

· Strong background in: Maintenance (equipment and facility systems), Production operations

· Working knowledge of ISO9001 and IATF 16949 standards (preferred)

· Ability to read and interpret prints and technical specifications

· Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills

· Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment.

· Possess our 5 core values: Respect, Do the Right Thing, Problem Solver, Make it Happen, Collaborate

**Work Environment**

· Manufacturing plant environment with a combination of office and shop floor responsibilities

· Requires regular presence on the production floor and interaction with all departments

· Fast-paced environment requiring strong cross-functional collaboration and quick decision-making

Join us as a Plant Manager to shape the future of our manufacturing operations! Bring your energy, strategic mindset, and leadership talent to help us achieve new heights of success.

Pay: From $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

records.description:
**PAFCO** is a $700MM+ global seafood manufacturing company with 50+ years of success. Our business is built on trust which has allowed both our company and our customers to succeed together. Learn more about the company at **www.pafco.net****.**

**Job Summary**:

The Plant Manager oversees **PAFCO**’s processing, warehousing, and distribution operations, ensuring strong performance in production, food safety, regulatory compliance, labor management, and financial results. The ideal candidate has experience in seafood or perishable food manufacturing, strong operational expertise, and proven leadership skills in a fast-paced, temperature-controlled environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily seafood processing, warehousing, and distribution operations to meet production, quality, and service goals.
* Develop production schedules based on customer demand, inventory, and supply requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement to increase efficiency, reduce waste, and minimize downtime.
* Monitor production, labor, inventory, and cost KPIs to ensure operational performance.
* Oversee refrigerated and frozen warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, and outbound shipping.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP, SQF/GFSI, FSMA, FDA, USDA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Lead food safety audits, sanitation programs, corrective actions, and regulatory inspections.
* Manage equipment maintenance, facility infrastructure, and capital improvement projects.
* Own the plant budget, forecasting, cost controls, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Lead and develop supervisors, leads, and production employees across multiple shifts.
* Partner with HR on recruiting, workforce planning, performance management, and training.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* 7–10 years of progressive plant or operations management experience in food manufacturing; seafood or perishable proteins preferred.
* Proven experience managing multi-shift operations, budgets, P&L, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Experience with WMS, ERP, and production scheduling systems.
* HACCP certification required; SQF Practitioner or PCQI preferred.
* Working knowledge of FDA/FSMA, COOL, OSHA, and cold-chain requirements.
* Familiarity with industrial refrigeration systems and temperature-controlled operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and KPI-driven decision-making skills.
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a diverse, multi-shift workforce.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively on the production floor and with senior leadership.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant operational leadership experience will be considered.

**Benefits**

* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Disability insurance
* Paid vacation leave
* 401k with employee matching

**Employment Eligibility**

* PAFCO **does not** offer sponsorship for this position

Description:

Magnum Venus Products (MVP) is a global manufacturer of fluid movement and production solutions for industrial applications in composites and adhesives markets. MVP collaborates with its customers to offer tailored production solutions to meter, mix, dispense, and apply materials. For over 80 years, MVP has been a leading equipment provider for the marine, infrastructure, pool and bath, oil & gas, transportation, aerospace, and wind industries.

As a family-owned business, MVP serves its customers and communities with integrity and respect to create a better experience. Our same core values with which the company was founded on 80 years ago continue to guide us today as we create a better experience for our employees, customers, and communities.

MVP proudly offers a competitive medical (partially Company-paid), dental, vision, life and disability plan; 401k retirement plan with a 4% match; Paid Time Off (starting at 13 days per year); 9 Company-paid holidays; 2 Floating holidays.

**Role Summary:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of multiple MVP manufacturing sites. This role leads site supervisors and teams, drives lean manufacturing and continuous improvement, and ensures quality, on-time delivery, and cost targets are met across all locations in their scope.

MVP is growing, and this role will play a key part in that growth, including consolidating and relocating sites and setting up warehouse and inventory operations, both physically and in our ERP system.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, develop, and mentor supervisors and team members across multiple sites, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and service to one another.
* Oversee daily operations at multiple sites.
* Create and maintain production schedules, goals, and assignments to meet plant objectives and customer delivery commitments.
* Drive lean manufacturing initiatives and continuous improvement to eliminate waste, reduce cost, and improve throughput and quality.
* Coordinate and align activities between departments and between sites to ensure consistent standards, shared resources, and effective communication.
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Management, and Sales to meet product, schedule, and customer requirements.
* Manage site budgets, labor, and resource allocation, and track key performance metrics (safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale).
* Maintain facilities and equipment to a high standard, including preventive maintenance and capital equipment needs.
* Lead site relocations and consolidations, including planning, equipment moves, layout, and minimizing disruption to production.
* Set up and organize warehouse operations, both physically (layout, storage, material flow) and virtually (ERP locations, transactions, and inventory accuracy).
* Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality requirements at every site.
* Hire, train, and conduct performance reviews for supervisor-level employees.
* Help direct and adhere to corporate initiatives in safety, quality, production, and supply chain.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a machine shop environment.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, including leading supervisors and multiple teams.
* Experience leading lean or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strategic and collaborative thinker with strong problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of business and management principles, quality, production, and supply chain.
* Ability to travel between sites regularly.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in a fabrication shop and in assembly operations.
* Experience relocating sites and setting up a warehouse, both physically and virtually (ERP/inventory systems).
* Bachelor's degree, engineering experience, or equivalent experience.
* Change management experience.

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to walk and stand throughout the shop floor and move between buildings and sites.
* Ability to climb ladders and operate or be around machinery and lifts.
* Ability to use PPE in a manufacturing environment where safety is a priority.
* Ability to drive between sites.

records.description:
**JOB TITLE: Plant Manager, Dutch Harbor**

**DEPARTMENT: Cesco Solutions**

**REPORTS TO: CCO, Cesco Solutions**

**STATUS: Full time, exempt**

**LOCATION: Dutch Harbor, AK**

**Travel required to Dutch Harbor, approximately 67% of the year in various intervals**

**SALARY: $130,000-$150,000 USD, + Dutch Harbor onsite pay and milestone bonus up to 50% of base salary**

**BENEFITS: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, optional FSA/HSA, 401k with 6% employer match, life and AD&D insurance, Employee Assistance Program, short & long term disability, tuition reimbursement, 8 weeks annual PTO**

**About Us:**

 

**Tidal Vision:**

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive and systemic environmental impact by making our biopolymer solutions cost competitive, more convenient, and better performing than the synthetic chemicals we displace. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We value open, direct communication and foster a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. We value our employees and demonstrate that through our compensation and benefits programs and opportunities for growth and development.

 

**About Cesco Solutions**: 
Cesco Solutions is the leader in creating client value in liquid/solids industrial water and process applications. Specializing in industries such as food & beverage, paper process and high-organics wastewater overall, we focus on eliminating waste/sludge through reduction and upcycling, at the same time, reducing contamination of downstream biological systems so they run more effectively and efficiently.

As part of Tidal Vision, Cesco leverages chitosan-based chemistry as a sustainable resource recovery approach, to traditional synthetic and metal-based chemistry, to improve paper strength, waste clarification, reduce sludge, and enhance treatment efficiency. By combining advanced chemistry, application expertise, and operational support, Cesco helps facilities optimize wastewater performance, lower chemical consumption, and maintain regulatory compliance while advancing more sustainable treatment practices.

 

**About Tidal Vision’s Unique Work Culture:**

Tidal Vision strives to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Plant Manager to lead the operations of our seafood processing facility in Dutch Harbor, AK. This individual will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, including production, food safety, quality assurance, maintenance, staffing, inventory management, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with experience managing manufacturing or food processing operations, preferably within the seafood, meat, poultry, dairy, or other protein processing industries. This role requires a strong commitment to employee development, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and delivering high-quality products to customers.

**Travel required to Dutch Harbor approximately 67% of the year in various intervals, with Dutch Harbor onsite per day bonus pay. Food and lodging provided.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operations Leadership:**

* Direct and oversee all daily plant operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and customer commitments are achieved.

* Develop production schedules that maximize throughput, efficiency, and product quality while minimizing downtime and waste.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to safety, productivity, labor efficiency, yield, quality, and on-time delivery.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and reduce costs.

* Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, maintenance, quality, and sales teams to ensure seamless operations.

 

**Team Leadership:**

* Lead, coach, and develop hourly production employees.

* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, employee engagement, and operational excellence.

* Conduct performance evaluations, succession planning, and leadership development activities.

* Recruit, train, and retain a high-performing workforce.

* Promote open communication and maintain positive employee relations.

 

**Food Safety & Quality:**

* Ensure compliance with all food safety and quality standards, including HACCP, FDA, USDA (where applicable), GMPs, SSOPs, and sanitation requirements.

* Support internal and external audits while maintaining regulatory compliance.

* Partner with Quality Assurance to investigate product issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

* Foster a culture where food safety and product quality are prioritized throughout the organization.

 

**Safety & Compliance:**

* Champion a strong workplace safety culture by ensuring compliance with OSHA regulations and company safety policies.

* Lead safety meetings, incident investigations, and corrective action initiatives.

* Maintain compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.

 

**Financial & Operational Performance**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operating expenses.

* Monitor labor costs, production yields, inventory levels, and operating efficiencies.

* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through process optimization and waste reduction.

* Prepare operational reports and present plant performance to senior leadership.

 

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement:**

* Partner with maintenance teams to ensure equipment reliability and minimize downtime.

* Support preventive maintenance programs and capital improvement projects.

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, and operational excellence.

 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Food Science, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing or food processing leadership experience.

* Strong leadership, communication, and employee development skills.

* Experience managing production schedules, labor planning, inventory, and operational budgets.

* Knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP, GMPs, sanitation programs, and quality systems.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in seafood, seafood processing, aquaculture, meat, poultry, dairy, or other protein processing operations.

* Experience with frozen, fresh, or value-added seafood products.

* Knowledge of seafood handling, cold chain management, and traceability requirements.

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.

* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

 

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to work in refrigerated, wet, and production environments.

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the facility.

* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.

* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hairnets, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and waterproof gear.

* Willingness to work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, or holidays as production demands require.

 

**Licensing & Special Requirements**

* Incumbent is subject to a background check.

 

*Tidal Vision provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

*The statements contained herein reflect general details as necessary to describe the principal functions of this job, the level of knowledge and skill typically required, and the scope of responsibility, but should not be considered an all-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned including work in other functional areas to cover absences or relief, to equalize peak work periods, or otherwise to balance the workload. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.*

records.title: Plant Operations Director
records.description:
**Your experience matters**

**Raleigh General Hospital** is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As a **Plant Operations Director** joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

**More about our team**

Our Plant Operations team plays a vital role in supporting patient care and hospital operations by maintaining the facilities, infrastructure, critical systems, and essential utilities that keep our hospital running safely and efficiently around the clock. In this dynamic, fast-paced healthcare environment, team members collaborate across clinical, administrative, and support departments to ensure operational reliability, maintain regulatory compliance, oversee facility improvements, and support the hospital's evolving needs.

Success in this role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, technical expertise, and a commitment to operational excellence, ensuring a safe, reliable, and well-maintained environment that supports our staff, patients, and visitors.

**How you’ll contribute**

As the **Plant Operations Director** you will excel in this role by:

* Strategic Leadership & Organizational Alignment: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant operations, ensuring departmental goals, initiatives, and resources align with the hospital's mission, vision, and organizational priorities.
* Plant Operations & Facilities Management: Direct and oversee daily plant operations, facilities maintenance, engineering services, building systems, and infrastructure to ensure safe, reliable, efficient, and uninterrupted hospital operations.
* Critical Infrastructure & Utility Management: Ensure the reliability, maintenance, and operational readiness of critical hospital systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, emergency power, medical gas systems, and other essential utilities.
* 24/7 Operational Readiness & Emergency Response: Ensure operational continuity through effective preventive maintenance, emergency preparedness, contingency planning, and timely response to equipment failures, utility disruptions, and other critical situations that may impact patient care.
* Capital Planning & Project Management: Lead long-term infrastructure planning, capital improvement initiatives, construction projects, renovations, and facility upgrades while managing project budgets, timelines, resources, and minimizing disruptions to hospital operations.
* Financial & Resource Management: Develop, manage, and monitor departmental budgets, staffing resources, operating expenditures, and capital investments while identifying opportunities for cost containment, resource optimization, and improved operational efficiency.
* Leadership & Workforce Development: Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team through effective workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, ongoing training, and succession planning while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Regulatory Compliance, Life Safety & Risk Management: Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, building codes, life safety requirements, environmental standards, and organizational policies while maintaining survey readiness and proactively mitigating operational risks.
* Performance Management & Continuous Improvement: Establish and monitor key performance indicators, evaluate departmental performance, coordinate internal and external audits, and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality, reliability, productivity, and operational effectiveness.
* Executive & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with executive leadership, clinical departments, physicians, support services, vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders to address operational priorities, support patient safety, maintain an exceptional healthcare environment, and advance the hospital's strategic objectives.

**Why join us**

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.
* **Financial Protection & PTO**: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.
* **Financial & Career Growth**: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.
* **Employee Well-being**: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs)
* **Professional Development**: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.
* Significant progressive leadership experience in plant operations, facilities management, engineering, or infrastructure operations, preferably within a large, complex hospital or healthcare environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing large-scale facilities, critical infrastructure, building systems, utilities, preventive maintenance programs, and 24/7 operational environments.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, life safety codes, Environment of Care, emergency preparedness, and applicable safety and compliance standards.
* Proven financial management experience, including departmental budgeting, expense control, capital planning, resource allocation, and vendor and contract management.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and engage high-performing teams, manage workforce performance, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to oversee complex infrastructure projects, prioritize competing demands, and drive operational improvements.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with executive leadership, clinical teams, physicians, contractors, vendors, and other key stakeholders.

**More about Raleigh General Hospital**

**Raleigh General Hospital** cares for nearly 13,000 patients each year and treats more than 50,000 patients in its emergency room. We are accredited by the Joint Commission, the nationally recognized accrediting agency for healthcare facilities. Raleigh General Hospital also offers instructional programs for nursing students as well as numerous allied health student extern programs.

**EEOC Statement**

“Raleigh General Hospital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Raleigh General Hospital is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment in employment.”

 
We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.

records.description:
**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve quality performance, reduce scrap and rework, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Develop leaders and employees through coaching, succession planning, workforce development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Utilize KPIs and operational metrics to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive sustainable business improvements.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or similar senior manufacturing leader.
* Proven success managing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve and sustain performance targets in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and operational expenses.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Experience supporting or maintaining IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Certified Manufacturing Manager (CMfgM), PMP certification, or similar professional credentials.
* Master's degree in a related discipline.

Why you'll want to join our team:

* Lead a critical manufacturing operation with broad operational responsibility.
* Make a meaningful impact on plant performance, customer satisfaction, and company growth.
* Partner with an experienced leadership team in a collaborative environment.
* Drive operational excellence and shape the future of the facility.
* Develop and mentor the next generation of manufacturing leaders.
* Influence strategic initiatives, capital investments, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive benefits and salary package being offered for this role.

This position is based on-site in Warren, MI and requires a strong presence on the production floor. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, supplier visits, training, and corporate initiatives.

records.description:
Vice President of Manufacturing – North America

**Confidential Executive Search | Multi-Site Manufacturing Leadership**

**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Manufacturing will provide strategic and operational leadership across an extensive North American manufacturing network, with accountability for safety, quality, productivity, financial performance, employee engagement, and customer service.

As a senior leader within the organization, this individual will play a critical role in shaping the long-term manufacturing strategy, translating enterprise objectives into measurable operational results, and building a culture centered on accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and operational discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across a multi-site manufacturing network throughout the United States and Canada.
* Champion a safety-first culture, ensuring environmental, health, safety, and regulatory compliance standards are embedded throughout manufacturing operations.
* Establish and drive operational performance standards across safety, quality, productivity, cost, delivery, and employee retention.
* Lead transformational initiatives leveraging Lean manufacturing, advanced analytics, technology, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Partner with executive leadership and provide strategic insights and operational performance updates to the C-suite and Board of Directors.
* Drive consistency, standardization, and accountability through effective operational governance and performance management systems.
* Develop a robust manufacturing leadership pipeline through succession planning, talent development, and organizational capability building.
* Partner with Human Resources to strengthen employee engagement, improve retention, and foster a high-performance culture.
* Oversee manufacturing budgets and financial performance, ensuring effective resource allocation, cost optimization, and profitability.
* Collaborate with senior leaders across Supply Chain, Engineering, Environmental Health & Safety, Maintenance, and Quality to achieve enterprise-wide objectives.
* Lead strategic manufacturing initiatives that support business growth, operational scalability, and long-term competitive advantage.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-site manufacturing operations.
* Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in safety, operational performance, quality, productivity, and cost.
* Extensive knowledge of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and operational excellence methodologies.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing multi-million-dollar operating budgets.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational and cultural transformation.
* Experience developing high-performing leadership teams and building organizational capabilities.
* Exceptional executive presence, communication, and cross-functional relationship-building skills.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with a practical, hands-on approach to operational execution.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We are seeking a manufacturing executive who brings both strategic vision and operational depth. The successful candidate will be an influential, people-focused leader who understands how to drive sustainable business results through strong leadership, disciplined execution, and a culture of continuous improvement.

This individual will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future direction of manufacturing within an established global organization.

Pay: $200,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

records.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position operates in both office and manufacturing floor environments and requires a leader who is comfortable engaging directly with engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation.

The expected base salary range for this position is **$220,600 – $314,050 annually**, representing the company's current good-faith estimate of compensation.

Actual compensation will depend on factors including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and specific work location.

This position may also be eligible for:

* Performance-based bonuses
* Equity compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings benefits
* Paid time off
* Wellness resources

TransMedics complies with all applicable U.S. pay transparency laws and does not request or consider salary history.

**About TransMedics**
---------------------

TransMedics is transforming organ transplantation through innovative technologies designed to improve the availability, utilization, and outcomes of donor organs.

Our mission is to help save more lives by advancing the science and technology of organ preservation and transplantation.

Join a growing organization where engineering innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful impact come together to advance life-saving technology.

This is a full-time, **on-site position** currently based at TransMedics' facility in Andover, MA.

TransMedics is preparing to transition operations to a new facility in **Somerville, MA**. Candidates should be aware of this upcoming move and must be willing and able to work on-site at both locations as the transition occurs.

Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the work location or be willing to relocate to the Greater Boston area.

This position requires regular collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams, including direct engagement on the manufacturing floor.

TransMedics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

TransMedics is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process.

We value the unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences of our employees and believe that an inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate and fulfill our mission of saving lives.

**Employee Benefit:**

Medical with Health Reimbursement Account through Blue Cross/Blue Shield of MA

Dental

Vision

Healthcare Flexible Spending Account

Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Short Term Disability

Long Term Disability

401K Plan

Pet insurance

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

TransMedics is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, marital status, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

records.title: Sr. Director of Quality
records.description:
The Senior Director of Quality is responsible for leading quality, regulatory compliance, and functions at an assigned facility while providing strategic leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments across multiple FCAH locations and operating companies. This role ensures compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, customer, and industry requirements while driving consistency in quality standards, processes, audit readiness, corrective actions, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Senior Director serves as a hands-on quality leader at their assigned location while partnering with site leadership and other Quality leaders to strengthen quality systems, address regulatory and operational risks, develop quality teams, and promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across the organization.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Site Quality Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Quality department at the assigned facility, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Partner with site leadership, Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other departments to integrate quality into daily operations and decision-making.
* Oversee site quality personnel, including staffing, performance management, training, development, and accountability.
* Ensure the facility maintains required certifications, approvals, manuals, procedures, and quality systems.
* Monitor site quality performance, identify areas of risk, and develop action plans to address deficiencies and improve operational performance.

**Multi-Site Quality Leadership & Support**

* Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments and leaders across other First Class Air operating companies and locations.
* Partner with site Quality leaders to identify challenges, strengthen quality processes, and improve regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Promote consistency in quality standards, processes, procedures, and best practices across locations where appropriate.
* Assist other locations with quality initiatives, regulatory concerns, audit preparation, corrective actions, customer issues, and process improvement efforts.
* Conduct site visits to evaluate quality systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide support to local Quality teams.
* Share lessons learned, recurring quality issues, and best practices across locations to prevent repeat findings and improve overall organizational performance.
* Help develop and implement company-wide quality initiatives while allowing for site-specific requirements, certifications, and regulatory differences.
* Escalate significant regulatory, operational, customer, or quality risks to executive leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Oversight**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, , customer, and other regulatory requirements, as applicable to company operations.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, including Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Serve as a point of contact for regulatory authorities, customer representatives, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure applicable requirements are communicated and implemented across affected locations.
* Ensure maintenance, repair, overhaul, inspection, manufacturing, and other applicable activities are performed in accordance with approved technical data, regulatory requirements, and established procedures.
* Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) at the assigned location and across other locations as needed.
* Establish and promote consistent quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization.
* Oversee the development, revision, and implementation of quality manuals, procedures, inspection programs, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate document control, records management, inspection processes, calibration programs, personnel qualifications, training, and other critical quality system controls are maintained.
* Partner with site and enterprise leadership to improve quality processes, reduce risk, and enhance operational performance.

**Audits, Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and oversee internal, external, regulatory, customer, and third-party audits at the assigned facility.
* Support and provide guidance to other locations in preparation for and execution of audits.
* Develop and support risk-based audit schedules and audit strategies.
* Ensure audit findings and quality issues are appropriately investigated, contained, corrected, and documented.
* Oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes and ensure root cause analysis is appropriately performed.
* Verify corrective actions are effective and prevent recurring issues.
* Identify recurring findings, systemic quality issues, and trends across locations and implement improvements where appropriate.

**Airworthiness & Technical Quality**

* Provide oversight of airworthiness and return-to-service processes across applicable repair station operations.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, inspection, certification, and related airworthiness documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure receiving, in-process, and final inspections are performed in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
* Oversee the management and control of capability lists, personnel authorizations, technician and inspector qualifications, stamps, and related records.
* Ensure calibration programs and control of tools, equipment, and test instruments meet applicable requirements.
* Assist other locations with technical quality concerns, inspection processes, airworthiness issues, and regulatory interpretations as needed.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Provide leadership and support in resolving significant customer quality concerns, escalations, and recurring issues.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure customer quality expectations are understood and met.
* Monitor supplier-related quality trends and recurring issues.
* Support supplier corrective actions, quality investigations, and improvement initiatives as needed.
* Serve as a quality escalation resource for customer and supplier issues across locations.

**Quality Performance, Reporting & Risk Management**

* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, KPIs, trends, and reporting processes for the assigned facility.
* Support the development and implementation of company-wide quality dashboards and performance metrics.
* Evaluate quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate significant quality concerns, regulatory risks, audit findings, and improvement initiatives to site leadership and executive leadership.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize quality initiatives and allocate resources appropriately.
* Provide visibility into quality performance across locations and recommend actions to improve overall company performance.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in aviation, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Compliance,, Inspection, or related functions preferred.
* Significant experience leading Quality functions within aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, manufacturing, or FAA-certified repair station environments.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience working directly with FAA, EASA, UK CAA, customer representatives, or other regulatory authorities preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, customer, internal, and external audits.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining Quality Management Systems.
* Strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, particularly Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Knowledge of EASA, UK CAA,, and other applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause analysis, risk management, audit processes, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret technical data, regulatory requirements, manuals, procedures, engineering documentation, and quality standards.
* This role will require 20%-30% travel to other facilities

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Location:

Garden City, NY, US, 11530

Business Unit: Treitler FMH

Posting Date: Nov 20, 2026

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for leading Hughes-Treitler operations to achieve business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This hands-on leadership role provides strategic and day-to-day direction for manufacturing, materials, and operational excellence while ensuring the organization has the talent, capacity, processes, and resources required to support current demand and business growth. The Director establishes operating plans, drives accountability, builds organizational capability, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance, expand capacity, control costs, and strengthen customer responsiveness.

 

**Supervisory Responsibilties:**

The position has direct reports but must be able to work in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Production in support of the departmental objectives. 



**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop Operations teams to effectively support day-to-day execution, strategic business objectives, customer requirements, and growth plans.
* Establish operating strategies, objectives, budgets, capital requirements, material plans, labor requirements, and organizational priorities aligned with customer and business needs.
* Ensure the organization is structured and staffed with the talent, resources, and capabilities needed to meet customer quality, technical, delivery, and turnaround-time expectations.
* Partner with business leadership to achieve key performance indicators, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, throughput, backlog reduction, customer lead time, productivity, labor utilization, cost, and profitability.
* Lead the development and execution of the site Lean and Operational Excellence roadmap, using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, TPM, SIOP and daily management practices to improve flow, yield, cycle time, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and monitor operating standards, performance metrics, and management routines that drive accountability, timely problem-solving, and sustained results.
* Drive capacity planning and expansion initiatives, including capital equipment, automation, facility, tooling, staffing, and process investments required to support business growth.
* Manage operating expenses and capital investments in accordance with approved budgets; identify and execute cost-reduction and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure effective planning and control of materials, inventory, suppliers, production schedules, and labor resources to support quality, cost, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to resolve operational issues, support new product introductions, strengthen manufacturability, and meet customer requirements.
* Provide leadership for robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer performance.
* Participate in the development and execution of the business strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable operating plans and measurable objectives.
* Support commercial and customer-facing activities, including operational reviews, pricing and capacity analyses, customer visits, and performance presentations.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain operations talent through performance management, career development, succession planning, cross-training, and ongoing capability building.
* Foster a culture of accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Author annual performance reviews and develop continuing education and advancement paths for entire department.
* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost performance, including identifying suitable use cases and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs.
 

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to establish performance metrics, analyze operating data, prioritize competing demands, and drive accountability for results.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective work relationships.
* Strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to balance customer requirements with operational, financial, and organizational priorities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a hands-on leadership presence across the operation.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and manufacturing systems; experience with SIOP or related planning processes preferred.
* Demonstrated history of successful change management and implementation of operational excellence improvements.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization from the production floor to the executive office.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed to support business requirements.
 

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or another related technical discipline required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience in a low-volume/high-mix, build-to-order, or engineered-products environment; experience in aerospace, defense, metal-forming, precision machining, brazing, welding, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading salaried and hourly employees.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement programs with measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational planning, capital and capacity expansion, production and materials management, cost optimization, organizational improvements, and customer-facing operational reviews.

**Other:**

* Due to the nature of Hughes-Treitler's programs and products, applicants must have the legal right to work in the US and additionally must be legally authorized to access export-controlled information and source code.
