records.title: EW Operations Engineering Director
records.description:
**Job Description** 
We are seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished EW Operations Engineering Director with strong Hardware, Systems, and RF design experience, to bridge the gap between advance systems development and factory production. This executive-level role requires a deeply experienced leader who understands product requirements and performance to oversee the complete Life Cycle Management (LCM) of complex hardware ensuring that highly sophisticated Digital and RF Designs seamlessly transition from design environments into full scale production.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in Electronic Warfare (EW) systems and acts as the ultimate authority and liaison between Systems/Hardware Designs engineering and Manufacturing Operations. You will champion “Left Shift” engineering philosophies-refining, shaping, and validating hardware configurations long before they reach the factory floor to optimize, yield, efficiency, and electrical and mechanical compliances
 
•**Key Responsibilities**
 
•**Strategic Operations and Factory Leadership**
 
•Production Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end process governing how critical hardware is moved, staged, and executes across factories of record.
 
•Factory of record integration: Maintain comprehensive understanding of the People, Build, Equipment limitations, Operational Rules and technical boundaries to align design tolerances with factory capabilities.
 
•Operational Compliance: Author, Develop, and Maintain the Manufacturing Design Rules Documents in collaboration with the process engineers and subject matter experts (SME). Establish robust mitigation strategies for Non-compliant or ‘Red” technical requirements
 
•Technology Insertion: Evaluate, introduce, and integrate new manufacturing and test technologies and evolving factory capabilities to continually improve product lines.
 
•**Cross-Functional Engineering Liaison & Governance**
 
•Design-to-Production: Acts as the strategic liaison between Systems/HW Design and Operations “Enforcing” high standard and quality for manufacturing readiness and knowing precisely when to push back on design elements that challenge manufacturability
 
•Change Control & Audits : Represent Operations by attending and activity presenting Manufacturability requirements at the Engineering Leadership CARBs (Change/Configuration Action review Boards)
 
•Compliance & Technical Reviews: Demonstrate, Organize and Execute Systems/HW programs reviews including CCB (Change Control Boards) and PRB (Program Review Boards) to mitigate electrical compliance
 
•Left Shift & Process Optimization: Drive early-Stage engagement through the P2L/NPI processes to shape, refine and mature hardware layouts prior to factory entry
 
•**Test Engineering Strategy and Operations Engagement**
 
•Production test architecture: Oversee and understand the vision and long-term production test strategy, ensuring test development frameworks are fully integrated with operations,
 
•Design-for-Test (DFT): Partner directly with Hardware Design and test development engineering to enforce strict Production Test requirements and enforcing the Operations Test Rules 
 
 
 
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

•Education: Bachelors or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Operations or a closely related technical discipline

•Experience Level: Minimum of 20+ years of dedicated System/HW designs and Engineering/Operational Leadership with complex digital and high-frequency RF hardware domain

•Domain Expertise: Technical proficiency of electronic warfare (EW) systems. Including an expert-level understanding of how the hardware behaves internally and externally under operating conditions. Understanding critical System Tradeoffs in electrical performance.

•LCM Mastery: Documented success reshaping the Life-Cycle Management (LCM) paradigms, establishing “Left-Shift” framework and streamlining product handoffs to manufacturing

•Governance: Extensive background running rigorous technical reviews, electrical compliance boards, CCBs and PRBs

 
 
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

•Cross Discipline Mobilization: Lead, Mentor and rally multi-discipline, cross-functional engineering and operational teams to achieve swift pragmatic solutions (Driving to high confidence \*80% rule)

Trend Analysis & Optimizations: Partner with the program engineering groups to monitor production trends, identify anomalies, isolate hardware failure modes, and making data driven discissions )
 
 
**Pay Information**
 
Full-Time Salary Range: $173023 - $294137
 
 
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
 
 
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. 
 
 
 
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
 
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
 
 
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
 
 
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
 

**Curious? Apply now!**

Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.

We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov

**Any further questions?**

If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

records.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $187,600 - $257,950, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

records.title: Senior Manager, US Quality Operations
records.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

As production grows, we need clear evidence that each spacecraft meets its requirements and a quality system that helps teams find and resolve risks early.

We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Quality Operations** to lead US quality for satellite buses and payloads from incoming material through building, test and acceptance. You will build a pragmatic system and lead engineers and inspectors close to the floor. You have independent authority to hold work or withhold readiness concurrence and to escalate unresolved mission risk. This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Lead US quality engineers and inspectors across supplier, receiving, production and test coverage. Set training, inspection points and delegated authority.
* Own fit-for-stage quality controls for document and configuration records, serial and lot traceability, calibration, nonconformances, corrective action and acceptance packages.
* Define risk-based controls for critical characteristics and supplier parts. Work with Supply Chain on qualifications, escapes, containment and verified corrective action.
* Make quality status visible through yield, repeat defects, escapes, NCR aging and acceptance-record completeness. Use trends to improve controls with Manufacturing and Engineering.
* Own the quality hold and escalation process. Engineering owns technical disposition; Quality evaluates controls and evidence and concurs on release.
* Concur independently on quality evidence at acceptance and flight readiness reviews. Escalate residual risk despite schedule pressure; partner with Engineering on reliability and mission risk.
* Align common requirements with the Canada Quality Lead and feed ground defects and on-orbit anomalies into later builds.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 8+ years in quality engineering or quality management for aerospace, defense or similarly complex hardware, including 3+ years directly leading engineers, inspectors or specialists through production and test.
* Experience building a usable QMS and leading teams through supplier escapes, nonconformances, root cause and corrective action.
* Independent judgment, strong technical communication and the ability to separate Engineering disposition from Quality release concurrence.
* Working knowledge of configuration control, risk-based inspection, process capability and cross-functional investigations.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, materials science, physics or a related technical field, or equivalent quality leadership experience in complex hardware.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $180K - $230K

postedPay.title: Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager - Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD)

records.description:
**Job Description**

**General Summary**
-------------------

The Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager provides technical leadership for commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD) at external manufacturing partners. The role is accountable for overseeing technical services activities across the commercial manufacturing lifecycle, including manufacturing readiness, process performance, technical investigations, change management, process improvement, and supply-risk mitigation.

The Senior Manager partners with Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and CDMOs/CMOs to ensure manufacturing processes are robust, compliant, reliable, and capable of supporting product supply. The role leads complex cross-functional technical workstreams and develops technical talent within the Manufacturing Technical Services organization.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead Manufacturing Technical Services support for assigned commercial manufacturing programs and external manufacturing partners.
* Establish technical plans and priorities to support manufacturing readiness, commercial production campaigns, product supply, and lifecycle-management objectives.
* Provide technical oversight during manufacturing execution; lead escalation and resolution of complex process, equipment, yield, and manufacturing-performance issues.
* Lead technical investigations of significant manufacturing deviations, process excursions, yield loss, equipment failures, and product-quality events; ensure root cause, technical impact, and sustainable corrective actions are clearly defined.
* Oversee manufacturing, process, analytical, and batch-performance trending to identify emerging risks, assess process robustness, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Lead technical assessment and approval of change controls, risk assessments, comparability assessments, process updates, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Partner with Manufacturing Operations and Supply Chain to assess technical constraints, manage manufacturing and supply risks, and develop recovery or mitigation plans.
* Lead technical governance with CDMOs/CMOs, including performance review, issue escalation, technical decision-making, data review, and follow-up of technical deliverables.
* Collaborate with MS&T, Quality, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure technical strategies align with process-validation requirements, cGMP expectations, regulatory commitments, and product lifecycle plans.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that enhance process robustness, product quality, yield, manufacturing efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Develop, mentor, and provide technical directions to Manufacturing Technical Services staff and matrixed technical teams.
* Travel to support on-site manufacturing activities, CDMO/CMO operations, audits, inspections, and business needs as required (10-20% travel expected)

**Knowledge and Skills**
------------------------

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, testing, controls, and commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD)
* Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices, pharmaceutical quality systems, and controlled-documentation requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with commercial manufacturing support, technical services, process monitoring, product lifecycle management, and external manufacturing oversight.
* Advanced experience leading complex technical investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, change controls, risk assessments, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Ability to interpret manufacturing, process, and analytical data; identify process-performance trends; assess technical risks; and recommend practical, sustainable solutions.
* Understanding of manufacturing operations, maintenance, engineering, equipment performance, capacity constraints, and supply-continuity planning.
* Experience leading CDMO/CMO technical relationships, including governance, performance management, technical issue resolution, and escalation.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, strategic-thinking, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and relevant manufacturing or business systems.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Typically requires 8+ years of experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, chemical, or another regulated manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant experience supporting commercial manufacturing operations, technical services, MS&T, process development, engineering, quality, or external manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical programs, manufacturing workstreams, complex investigations, process improvements, or cross-functional teams.
* Experience working in a cGMP environment and supporting controlled manufacturing documentation is required.
Demonstrate people leadership, matrix leadership, or technical leadership experience is required. 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$138,700 - $208,100

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. records.description:
Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics?Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics.
 
 
AtQnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries – we’re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. We value forward-thinking challengers, boundary-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us.
 
 
Senior Manager, Industrial Data& Manufacturing Systems Integration
 
 
**Function:** Integrated Operations& Technology, Digital TechnologyLocation: Wilmington, Delaware, Hybrid (other US Qnity locations may be considered)Travel: Approximately 20–30%Scope: Global, multi-site, and multi-vendor
 
 
Role Summary
 
 
The Senior Manager, Industrial Data& Manufacturing Systems Integration will own the enterprise agenda for industrial data and Level 3 integration across our global manufacturing network.
 
In this role, you will identify, develop, implement, and support two connected sets of systems:
 
 

* The historian and industrial data platform, including EMS/BMS, manufacturing intelligence, advanced analytics and AI, and digital twin capabilities
* The Level 3 integration and middleware layer that supports the platform, including equipment connectivity, edge gateways, orchestration, external-system integration, and twin synchronization

The mandate is to make data contextualization and a standardized edge gateway pattern work at scale. You will bring the architectural judgment needed to make platform decisions and the leadership required to align Manufacturing, Engineering, IT/OT, and external partners. Deep tool expertise will be provided by subject matter experts and specialist hires.
 
 
The Core Challenge
 
 
This role must protect plant-critical data flows and proprietary in-house assets, including custom drivers, tag structures, and site analytics, while establishing sufficient standardization across contextualization models, namespaces, edge patterns, integration contracts, and security.
 
Success requires sound judgment and trusted relationships with plants, engineers, and vendors. The right approach will balance enterprise standards with legitimate local requirements rather than applying a blanket rule such as “everything moves to the cloud” or “nothing leaves the plant.”
 
 
Core Capabilities
 
 
Selection for this role will be based on the following five capabilities, balanced across technical and people leadership. We expect sound architectural judgment, not hands-on expertise in every tool.
 
 
1. Technical Leadership of the Industrial Data and Integration Landscape
 
 
Own the platform decisions, including historian versus lakehouse, integration hub versus custom code, the appropriate edge pattern, and where contextualization should occur.
 
You will frame options; evaluate cost, latency, security, supplier risk, and intellectual property value; engage subject matter experts effectively; and take accountability for the outcome.
 
 
2. Implementing and Supporting Systems in an Operating Plant
 
 
Modernize historians, interfaces, and connectivity that plants rely on continuously without creating data gaps, breaking genealogy, or introducing silent changes to trusted data.
 
You will also establish stable, 24x7 support with clearly defined service levels, controls, and change-management practices.
 
 
3. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
 
 
Build early sponsorship with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Quality, Facilities, IT/OT Security, Data& AI, and site leaders across three regions.
 
Explain contextualization, edge technology, and digital twins in terms of business outcomes for audiences ranging from executives to the shop floor. Communicate risks, challenges, and changes early and clearly.
 
 
4. Collaboration Across IT, OT, and External Partners
 
 
Industrial data operates at the intersection of IT and OT and between internal teams and external suppliers.
 
Maintain OT-grade standards for segmentation, edge design, and change control while building effective partnerships with Controls, OT Security, subject matter experts, system integrators, and vendors.
 
 
5. Followership and Change Leadership Across Sites
 
 
Our Wilmington, Cheonan, and Hsinchu sites differ in regulatory requirements, engineering culture, and language. Common standards may encounter legitimate local concerns.
 
Build strong teams, determine what must be standardized and what may remain local, bring sites through the change, and stand behind both decisions.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Vision, Strategy, and Architecture
 
 

* Establish the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and ISA-95-aligned reference architecture for the industrial data platform and Level 3 integration layer.
* Govern a fit-for-purpose framework that determines what belongs in the historian, cloud platform, edge environment, integration hub, or custom code.
* Establish data contextualization as an enterprise capability by owning the common asset model, Unified Namespace, and contextualization standards across equipment, process, quality, energy, and facilities data.
* Standardize a secure, outbound-only edge gateway pattern for connectivity, protocol translation, buffering, and edge processing, enabling new equipment and sites to connect efficiently.

Historian and Data Platform Ownership
 
 

* Identify, implement, and support enterprise historians, such as AspenTech InfoPlus.21, including tag governance, retention, high availability, and migration.
* Develop and operate cloud data platforms, including Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, for time-series, contextualized, and EMS/BMS data, with governed data products and access controls.
* Deliver manufacturing intelligence, AI, and digital twin capabilities using platforms such as Seeq, Siemens Insights Hub, Cognite Data Fusion, and Azure Digital Twins.
* Establish the industrial knowledge model and appropriate responsible-AI controls.

Level 3 Integration, Edge, and Middleware Ownership
 
 

* Deploy and support equipment connectivity and edge gateways using technologies such as PTC Kepware, Litmus Edge, Ignition, and Azure IoT Operations across OPC UA, MQTT, SECS/GEM, and Modbus.
* Build and operate the Unified Namespace and contextualization layer using technologies such as HighByte Intelligence Hub, HiveMQ, and MQTT/Sparkplug B.
* Own orchestration and external-system integration using platforms such as Boomi and MuleSoft across MES, historians, digital twins, ERP, PLM, QMS, LIMS, and WMS, including twin synchronization.
* Ensure OT cybersecurity, data governance, and 24x7 resilience for data flows that are critical to shop-floor operations.
* Apply relevant standards and architectural models, including IEC 62443 and Purdue/DMZ principles.

Delivery and Support
 
 

* Own the complete system lifecycle, from business case development through design, implementation, hypercare, and ongoing support.
* Establish service levels, CI/CD practices, and OT-grade change control.
* Manage scope, budget, risk, and benefits across concurrent global rollouts.
* Coordinate platform suppliers, system integrators, and managed-service partners.

Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement, and Team Development
 
 

* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, IT/OT Security, MES, and Data& AI.
* Communicate technology strategy, business value, risks, and progress to executive stakeholders.
* Lead change management and adoption at each site.
* Build and develop a global team of architects, engineers, and product owners.
* Add subject matter experts and specialist capabilities where deeper technical expertise is required.

Required Qualifications
 
 
These qualifications represent minimum thresholds and are not the sole basis for selection.
 
 

* 8 or more years of experience in manufacturing IT/OT, including the delivery and support of historian, industrial data, MES, or OT integration systems in semiconductor, electronics, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Five or more years of experience leading distributed teams and multi-vendor programs with accountability for budgets and business benefits.
* Strong command of ISA-95, the Purdue model, contextualization and asset modeling, edge gateway architecture, OPC UA, MQTT, and OT security, with the ability to set direction and effectively challenge technical experts.
* Demonstrated stakeholder engagement and communication skills across audiences ranging from executives to the shop floor.
* A record of building teams and leading change across multiple sites.
* Commercial experience with RFx processes, contracts, licensing, and vendor governance.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications
 
 
The following qualifications may strengthen an application but do not replace the core capabilities and are not intended as initial screening requirements.
 
 

* Experience delivering at least one historian, data-platform, or integration modernization within an operating plant without loss of data continuity.
* Experience taking at least one greenfield or significant new-site deployment through implementation and into stable support.
* Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, or specialty materials.
* Working proficiency in Korean or Mandarin.
* Experience with technologies such as AVEVA PI, Seeq, Cognite Data Fusion, HighByte Intelligence Hub, PTC Kepware, or Databricks.
* Experience delivering an enterprise-scale Unified Namespace, digital twin, or manufacturing AI capability.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, SAFe, TOGAF, ISA/IEC 62443, Microsoft Azure, or Databricks.
* Experience in regulated-quality environments, including ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or GxP.
* Master’s degree or MBA.

Technical Environment
 
 
You will identify, develop, implement, and support the systems below while reshaping the technology landscape over time.
 
Many sites currently rely on in-house tools and point-to-point connections. You will determine what should be standardized, rationalized, migrated, or retained where it provides proprietary value. You are expected to understand how the components fit together and make sound platform decisions. Specialist depth will be provided by subject matter experts.
 
 
Historian and Data Platforms
 
 
**Technologies you may encounter or help select:** 

* Wonderware
* AspenTech InfoPlus.21
* Microsoft Fabric
* Databricks

Manufacturing Intelligence and AI
 
 
Technologies and capabilities you may encounter or help select:
 
 

* Seeq
* Siemens Insights Hub
* Azure AI and Copilot
* EMS/BMS energy and facilities data

Digital Twin and Knowledge Model
 
 
**Technologies and approaches you may encounter or help select:** 

* Cognite Data Fusion
* Azure Digital Twins
* ISA-95 asset hierarchies
* Industrial knowledge graphs

Edge Gateways and Equipment Connectivity
 
 
**Technologies and protocols you may encounter or help select:** 

* PTC Kepware
* Litmus Edge
* Ignition
* Azure IoT Operations
* OPC UA
* SECS/GEM
* Modbus
* PLC, DCS, and SCADA environments

Data Contextualization and DataOps
 
 
**Technologies and approaches you may encounter or help select:** 

* HighByte Intelligence Hub
* HiveMQ
* MQTT/Sparkplug B
* Unified Namespace
* ISA-95 asset models

Enterprise Integration
 
 
**Technologies and systems you may encounter or help select:** 

* Boomi
* MuleSoft
* MES
* SAP
* PLM
* QMS
* LIMS
* WMS

Standards and Security
 
 
**Standards and frameworks you may apply:** 

* ISA-95
* Purdue model
* IEC 62443
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* OPC UA companion specifications
* SEMI E30 and E164

Living the Qnity Values
 
 
At Qnity, success is measured not only bywhat we achieve, but also byhow we achieve it.
 
 

* Customer: Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, solve business challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
* Innovation: Continuously improve processes, technologies, and ways of working.
* Speed: Act with urgency, focus, and precision to move work forward and deliver results.
* People: Build trusted relationships, collaborate across teams, and inspire positive change.

Join ourTalent Community to stay connected with us!
 
 
Qnity is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation to search or apply for a position, please visit our Accessibility Page for Contact Information.
 
 
Qnity offers a comprehensive pay and benefits package. To learn more visit theCompensation and Benefits page.
 
 
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance our recruitment process.
 
The Pay range for this role is $108,500.00 - $170,500.00 Annual
 
**How Base Pay is Determined:** Qnity has job leveling frameworks that help organize roles based on progressive levels of responsibility, proficiency and qualifications. Each role has an associated pay range (or an established pay rate for some roles) based on the competitive market in each country where we operate. Each individual’s pay is based on a variety of factors, including their role and the associated pay range for that role, their geographic location (i.e., country, state, metropolitan area), as well as their skills, experience, education and certifications, and performance.

records.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems
records.description:
***Who We Are:***

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

***What We Do:***

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

***About the Role:***

We are seeking a **Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems,** who will provide leadership and oversight across key Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including quality events, investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control. This role will serve as a key quality partner across GxP functions, helping to identify systemic issues, strengthen investigation practices, and drive sustainable, risk-based improvements that support compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence. The role will work closely with internal teams and external service providers across Xenon’s outsourced operating model to ensure the QMS remains effective, compliant, and inspection ready.

The ideal candidate will bring strong Quality Systems experience, broad GxP knowledge, and sound business judgment, with the ability to effectively challenge investigations, facilitate meaningful root cause analysis, and influence stakeholders across functions. The role will also support quality governance, QMS metrics and trending, change control review, and the continued optimization of electronic quality systems.

This position reports to the Associate Director, Quality Assurance, Systems and will be based out of Boston, MA, USA in our Needham office. This role is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of two onsite days per week. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Systems & Governance**

 + Manage the oversight, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of GxP Quality Systems, including quality events, investigations, CAPA, change control, and associated governance processes.
 + Ensure consistent, risk-based practices for investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change management, including review and approval of records and escalation of significant quality or compliance risks.
 + Monitor QMS performance through metrics, trending, CAPA effectiveness, and Quality Management Review reporting to identify systemic risks and drive continuous improvement.
* **Compliance, Inspection Readiness & eQMS**

 + Assess QMS processes and proposed changes for GxP, regulatory, validation, training, documentation, and data integrity considerations, maintaining alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations.
 + Support the administration, optimization, validation, upgrades, and continuous improvement of the eQMS and associated procedures, guidance, and training.
 + Support regulatory inspections and internal and external audits, including inspection readiness and responses to observations and findings.
* **Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

 + Provide Quality Systems expertise, guidance, coaching, and training to promote consistent, inspection-ready, and risk-based quality practices across the organization.
 + Partner with GxP functions and external service providers to establish quality expectations, resolve quality issues, implement compliant changes and CAPAs, and drive cross-functional quality improvement initiatives.
 + Promote a strong quality culture through effective stakeholder engagement, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* **General Responsibilities**

 + Act in accordance with Company policies, including the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and ensure applicable policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any.
 + Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated industry, with demonstrated experience in Quality Systems, Quality Assurance, or compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with quality event management, including complex investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.
* Strong working knowledge of QMS requirements, quality risk management principles, and applicable GxP regulations, including GMP and familiarity with GCP, GVP, and GLP.
* Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems such as Veeva Quality, MasterControl, or equivalent, including supporting system implementation, optimization, or maintenance.
* Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining quality procedures, SOPs, metrics, and trending to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting quality governance activities, regulatory inspections, internal or external audits, and inspection readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders while effectively navigating ambiguity and driving quality initiatives to completion.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to execution.
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

Compensation Range: $131.3K - $173.3K

records.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
records.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

records.title: Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering
records.description:
**Continue to Grow with GXO.**

At GXO, we know our greatest asset is people like you - energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. Your career matters to us because your passion and excitement will help keep our company moving forward.

 

As the **Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering**, you will lead the development of facility layouts and designs, labor standards, staffing and efficiency analyses, and identify cost-saving opportunities while supporting operational implementations.

**Pay, benefits and more.**

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

**What you’ll do on a typical day:**

* Hire, train and develop industrial engineering staff; provide technical support and direction to site industrial engineers and managers
* Develop labor standards, process flow diagrams and job descriptions for new and existing operations
* Conduct time study analyses to estimate facility staffing requirements and establish production standards
* Identify, evaluate and implement productivity improvements
* Document processes to facilitate operational startups and provide on-site support as required
* Convert contract documents and SOWs into work instructions and operating procedures
* Analyze ongoing costs and compare them to prior cost and pricing estimates
* Select appropriate models for receiving, put-away, picking and packing solutions
* Identify storage and picking strategies based on product dimensions and activity levels
* Identify facility design requirements based on activity levels, product envelopes, product flow, transportation methods, building layout and power requirements
* Specify material handling and storage equipment solutions, including automation where justified
* Collaborate with IT resources to develop equipment requirements based on activity levels

**What you need to succeed at GXO:**

At a minimum, you’ll need:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience
* 5+ years of experience working in a warehouse, distribution or 3PL environment
* Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Experience with Labor Management Systems (LMS)
* Project management experience, including leading projects from concept through completion
* Experience with Lean Methodology and AutoCAD
* Familiarity with Six Sigma practices and principles

It’d be great if you also have:

* Advanced degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field
* 7 years of industrial engineering experience in a distribution environment
* 2 years of supervisory or management experience
* SQL experience

**We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.**

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
records.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.

* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience

* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

###

* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). records.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

records.title: Senior Manager Quality
records.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
