records.title: Sr. Manager Accounting Operations
records.description:
Nova Biomedical: One Global Brand. One Vision. Together under one name.

Advanced Instruments and Nova Biomedical are now united under one brand, Nova Biomedical, marking a major milestone in our journey to deliver greater value to our customers. By combining our strengths, we're accelerating innovation, supporting critical workflows, and delivering world-class service across the biopharmaceutical and clinical markets.

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager Accounting Operations leads the organization’s payables and receivables functions, ensuring accurate and timely transaction processing, effective cash management, strong internal controls, and excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. This role manages daily operations, develops team capability, drives process improvements, and partners across Finance, Procurement, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and support business objectives.

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Leadership and team management:** Lead, coach, and develop Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable staff; establish priorities, clarify responsibilities, monitor performance, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented culture.
* **Accounts Payable:** Oversee invoice processing, approval workflows, vendor maintenance, payment runs, employee expense reimbursements, and issue resolution while ensuring payments are accurate, timely, properly authorized, and compliant with company policies.
* **Accounts Receivable:** Oversee customer invoicing, cash application, account reconciliation, collections, credit administration, dispute resolution, and aging review to support timely cash conversion and minimize past-due balances.
* **Travel Management:** Lead global adoption and upkeep of SAP Concur, manage global travel policy, partner with global travel management vendor, liaise with Treasury on credit card solutions and integrations to Concur and ERP, and reconcile related balance sheet balances and accruals.
* **Close and reconciliation:** Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities, including subledger reconciliations, accrual support, aging analysis, and resolution of reconciling items.
* **Controls and compliance:** Maintain strong internal controls, segregation of duties, and complete documentation; support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and company policies.
* **Cash flow and reporting:** Monitor payables and receivables trends, prepare cash requirement and collection forecasts, and provide accurate metrics and analysis to Finance leadership.
* **Process improvement:** Identify and implement opportunities to standardize, automate, and streamline processes; strengthen data quality, cycle time, scalability, and the stakeholder experience.
* **Systems and master data:** Support effective use of ERP, banking, expense, and workflow systems; maintain accurate vendor and customer master data and participate in system implementations or enhancements.
* **Business partnership:** Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, Treasury, Tax, and other partners to address root causes, resolve escalated issues, and improve end-to-end processes.
* **Risk management:** Implement controls that reduce fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, bad debt, and credit exposure; escalate significant risks promptly.
* Develop, document, and maintain policies, procedures, service standards, and business continuity plans for both functions.
* Perform other responsibilities and special projects as assigned.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, accounting operations, or a related field, including at least three years of people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated knowledge of invoice-to-pay and order-to-cash processes, general ledger interfaces, reconciliations, month-end close, internal controls, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort using reporting and workflow tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions and with customers and vendors.
* High degree of accuracy, integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* CPA, CMA, CAPP, CICP, or other relevant professional certification preferred.
* Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency, manufacturing, life sciences, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Experience with shared services, system implementation, process automation, or continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Concur preferred.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Comfort with working at a computer for extended periods.

* Capacity to lift and carry up to [25–50] pounds as required

* Able to communicate effectively via phone, video, and written communication.

* Occasional need to move about the office to access meetings or resources.

**Why Work for Nova Biomedical**

* Flexible Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
* Competitive 401k company match
* Bonus Program, Generous PTO and paid holidays
* Generous Tuition reimbursement
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Professional development, engagement and events
* Company marketplace for lunch and snacks in our Norwood, MA, Billerica, MA and Westbrook, ME offices
* Company subsidized cafeteria in our Waltham, MA office

**Work Location:** Hybrid in **Waltham, MA**

**Targeted Salary Range:** **$180,000-$220,000/yr**

Nova Biomedical believes in transparency and integrity throughout all we do, including compensation. The provided salary range for this role represents the expected base salary or hourly rate for this opening. Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and may vary based on individual factors such as location, skills, and education.
 
 
About the company

At Nova Biomedical, we’re not just building instruments, we’re powering breakthroughs that improve lives. Our smart, science-driven solutions are trusted in over 100 countries to speed drug development and enhance patient care.

Our integration brings together more than 70 years of scientific excellence with Nova’s cutting-edge innovation, forming a powerhouse of precision, purpose, and possibility. With FDA-registered, ISO-certified manufacturing, more than 125 FDA approvals, and industry-trusted diagnostics, we’re setting new standards in quality and reliability. Nova Biomedical is proud to be a global leader in osmolality testing and biotechnology and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instrumentation, dedicated to advancing patient care and scientific discovery with a legacy that continues to shape the future of life sciences.

With headquarters in Norwood and Waltham, Massachusetts, and a global team of nearly 2,000 employees, we’re building a collaborative, empowered culture grounded in shared values: Customer Centricity, Ingenuity, Ownership & Accountability, Collaboration, and Integrity.

Working at Nova Biomedical means joining a mission-driven organization where your contributions matter. Whether you're in engineering, science, manufacturing, or support, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in your growth, and is committed to making a real-world impact on global health.

Explore what’s next with us at novabiomedical.com

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
records.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

**Description:**
----------------

**Director of Operations**

Take on a highly visible leadership role at NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center, helping shape the continued growth and evolution of a highly dynamic campus. As the Director of Operations, you will provide operational leadership for a portfolio of clinical programs and campus initiatives. You will work closely with senior, clinical and administrative leaders to advance strategic priorities, support growth, and ensure high-quality, efficient and patient-centered operations. The Director will have administrative oversight of key clinical services and play a significant role in capital and construction projects across the campus. This includes operational planning, construction coordination, logistics, moves and relocations, and the activation of new and renovated spaces.

The Director will also help plan for clinical capacity and growth, working with clinical and operational leaders to anticipate future needs and align space, resources, workflows and infrastructure to support evolving patient care and new programs. Serving as a key interdisciplinary partner across the campus, the Director will bring together physicians, nursing, clinical departments, support services, Facilities, Engineering, Design & Construction, Finance and other teams to coordinate complex initiatives and solve operational challenges.

The Director will also lead organizational readiness initiatives and support emergency preparedness and other campus priorities on behalf of senior leadership.

**Preferred Criteria**

 

* Master’s Degree in Business Administration, HealthCare Administration or related field

**Required Criteria**

 

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration or related field
* Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive responsible experience in business planning and process improvement, including five (5) years of management experience in a hospital setting
* Consistent demonstration of a commitment to quality, customer-centeredness, productivity and process improvement.
* Proven ability to direct and manage with concurrent responsibility for more than one operational area
* Demonstrate success in effectively leading a highly matrixed/cross-functional environment
* Demonstrated leadership, communication and interpersonal skills

records.description:
Director of Operations – Dave’s Hot Chicken

**Position:** Director of Operations

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** Restaurant / Multi-Unit Operations

About the Role

Dave’s Hot Chicken is looking for a highly motivated, results-driven **Director of Operations** to lead and support our growing restaurant operations.

This position is responsible for driving operational excellence across multiple locations while developing strong leaders, building a high-performance culture, delivering an exceptional guest experience, and achieving financial results.

We are looking for a leader who understands that great restaurant operations start with **great people**. The Director of Operations will work closely with General Managers and restaurant leadership teams to create accountability, consistency, and a culture where team members feel supported, challenged, recognized, and given opportunities to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and oversight for multiple Dave’s Hot Chicken locations.
* Ensure restaurants consistently execute Dave’s Hot Chicken operational standards, food quality, cleanliness, hospitality, and brand expectations.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and provide clear, actionable feedback to leadership teams.
* Identify operational opportunities and develop plans to improve restaurant performance.
* Ensure restaurants are properly staffed and prepared to execute at a high level.
* Maintain strong standards for food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance.

People & Leadership Development

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing General Managers and restaurant leaders.
* Build a strong pipeline of future General Managers, Area Leaders, and other operations leaders.
* Create individualized development plans for key leaders and high-potential team members.
* Hold leaders accountable while providing the coaching, tools, and resources necessary for them to succeed.
* Recognize outstanding performance and create a culture where accomplishments are celebrated.
* Ensure leaders are actively developing their teams rather than simply managing daily operations.
* Promote a culture of respect, communication, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Financial Performance

* Take ownership of restaurant sales, profitability, labor, food cost, controllable expenses, and overall financial performance.
* Analyze P&L statements and restaurant performance reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Develop action plans to improve underperforming locations.
* Partner with restaurant leadership to increase sales while maintaining appropriate labor and cost controls.
* Establish clear performance expectations and follow up consistently on results.

Guest Experience

* Ensure every restaurant delivers a consistently outstanding guest experience.
* Monitor guest feedback and identify recurring opportunities.
* Coach restaurant leaders on hospitality, speed of service, order accuracy, food quality, and restaurant cleanliness.
* Ensure guest concerns are handled quickly, professionally, and appropriately.

New Restaurant Openings & Growth

* Support new restaurant openings, including staffing, training, leadership development, and operational readiness.
* Build leadership benches ahead of organizational growth.
* Help establish scalable systems and processes as the organization adds locations.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop strategies that support long-term growth.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

* 7+ years of progressive restaurant operations leadership experience.
* 3+ years of successful multi-unit leadership experience.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurant locations.
* Proven ability to develop General Managers and build leadership pipelines.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&L management, labor, food cost, sales building, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to improve restaurant performance and hold teams accountable for results.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication, coaching, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance **people, operations, guest experience, and profitability**.
* Willingness to travel regularly between restaurant locations.
* Must be willing to work weekend, nights and availability to travel.

The Leader We Want

We are looking for someone who:

* **Leads from the front** and is comfortable spending significant time inside the restaurants.
* Builds relationships and earns the trust of their teams.
* Sets high expectations without losing sight of the people responsible for delivering the results.
* Develops leaders instead of simply giving directions.
* Recognizes and rewards great performance.
* Communicates clearly and follows through on commitments.
* Makes decisions based on both operational data and what is actually happening inside the restaurants.
* Takes ownership and expects the same from their leadership team.
* Understands that sustainable financial performance comes from strong operations, strong leadership, and engaged teams.
* Is passionate about building a winning culture while growing the Dave’s Hot Chicken brand.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means:

**Great People. Great Restaurants. Great Guest Experiences. Strong Financial Results.**

The Director of Operations will be expected to build restaurants where team members want to work, leaders have opportunities to grow, guests want to return, and the business consistently delivers strong results.

Why Join Dave’s Hot Chicken?

This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a rapidly growing restaurant brand. You will have the ability to influence operations, develop future leaders, support restaurant growth, and help create a culture built around accountability, recognition, development, and operational excellence.

**Dave’s Hot Chicken is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

records.description:
Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell is a leading Mexican-inspired quick service restaurant brand that is a part of Yum! Brands, Inc. which includes Pizza Hut and KFC. Founded on innovation and passion with Glen Bell bringing tacos to the masses in a world of hot dog and hamburger stands in 1962, today we have nearly 7000 restaurants in the United States and over 400 restaurants in 27 countries outside of the United States. The future holds 2,000 more restaurants across the globe within the next decade. It's easy to see we're in the business of making tacos, but at heart, we're a business that's fueled by the Live Mas energy and passion of people serving people.

What is "Live Mas"?

Equally important to the job role and responsibilities is making sure the Director of Operations can represent the amazing Live Mas! culture that is Taco Bell. At Taco Bell, we embrace breakthrough thinking and innovative ideas that continue to differentiate us from our competitors. We have a maniacal focus on our customers, never follow, and always celebrate the accomplishments of our people. If you want to have fun serving great food to our customers, we would love to meet with you.

Job Description:

About this Job: Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations is responsible for all aspects of operations including people, customers, sales and profits. This leader has up to 3 area coaches as direct reports compiling 12 restaurants. They drive excellence in day-to-day operations; hire, train, coach, & support managers; plan and set goals; focus on problem solving/process improvement; set standards; recognize and motivate area managers, unit level management & their teams. Influence people to drive business results and franchise partnership

The Day-to-Day:

Build People Capability

* Recruit and equip the best operators in the world to deliver great customer experiences
* Build a healthy and robust bench of developed and capable Managers
* Hold Area Coaches accountable for people, customer, sales and profit targets
* Lead by example be a culture champion and live by Taco Bell principles
* Leverage culture and people capability to fuel brand performance
* Resolution oriented in all Employee Relations (ER) activities; provides needed
ER assistance to managers; proactive in addressing ER needs in the market 

 

Deliver a Consistent Customer Experience

* Provides leadership for each manager in the market to ensure customer satisfaction
* Leverage customer programs to coach and improve on execution opportunities
* Train, coach and hold accountable Area Coaches and Restaurant Managers for executing the Taco Bell Operating System and delivering Brand Standards including food safety
* Identify and act with urgency to resolve Brand protection issues
* Excellent execution of Global Operating System initiatives
* Absolutely uncompromising execution of the highest standards of their local regulation around occupational safety and health standards for employee working conditions, and their company safety and security policy

Grow the Brand, Sales, and Profits

* Partners with each Manager in the market to build sales over last year's sales achievement
* Training and operations execution of marketing promotions
* Train and coach Area Coaches how to teach RGMs to use the tools and processes to improve restaurant financial results
* Coach to deliver restaurant profit targets in every restaurant
* Leads the way by working with each Area Coach in the market to deliver profit goals and meet targeted flow-thru objectives; utilizes available reports to identify opportunities; encourages a top-line orientation through operational focus; ensures that correct operational procedures are followed at all times
* Build capability to improve problem solving and planning skills through hands-on demonstrations
* Exhibits ownership working with Management to resolve chronic Repair & Maintenance issues; determines causes of excessive R&M; gathers R&M issues; identifies trends and takes to R&M Business Partners

Minimum Requirements-

Is This You?

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* Strong Quick Service Restaurant Experience, balancing product quality with fast service times
* Is a Dynamic, energetic and positive leader, a self-starter, proactively driven to get things done and does the right thing for the business
* Exhibits unrivaled leadership behaviors; providing coaching, developing the team, driving culture, problem solving, strong communication, time management, executing tasks and achieving results through others
* 10+ years Restaurant Management experience with strong people growing record, recruiting talent, development and performance management
* Corporate restaurant company field operations leader experience
* Has lead multiple managers of multiple high volume units in an area
* Extensive Area Coach experience leading 6-8 restaurant general managers
* Has personally ran a successful restaurant and has knowledge of restaurant operations and expectations for team member's positions
* Corporate office Cross-Functional leading teams experience
* Good communication skills, and strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills with exceptional team building capability

Why Taco Bell?

We truly believe that where you work matters, and we know a thing or two about what makes employees happy. Join us on our mission of feeding people's lives with Mas!

* We are about more than just building restaurantswe connect with our fans through their passions including sports, gaming, and music
* We know that employees want a company they can live and grow with; they crave a unique culture that fosters creativity and encourages pursuit of passion, and they look for opportunities to take risks, develop skills and learn in ways that fit their lifestyle
* We foster a culture of authenticity and believe all people can make a difference

records.description:
**Company Description**

A best-in-class city that attracts best-in-class talent, Philadelphia is an incredible place to build a career. From our thriving arts scene and rich history to our culture of passion and grit, there are countless reasons to love living and working here. With a workforce of over 30,000 people, and more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia offers boundless opportunities to make an impact.

As an employer, the City of Philadelphia values inclusion, integrity, innovation, empowerment, and hard work above all else. We offer a vibrant work environment, comprehensive health care and benefits, and the experience you need to grow and excel. If you’re interested in working with a passionate team of people who care about the future of Philadelphia, start here.

***What we offer***

* **Impact** - The work you do here matters to millions.
* **Growth** - Philadelphia is growing, why not grow with it?
* **Diversity & Inclusion** - Find a career in a place where everyone belongs.
* **Benefits** - We care about your well-being.

***Agency Description***

The mission of the Department of Revenue is to collect tax and non-tax revenue due to the City and tax revenue due to the School District of Philadelphia while providing service to customers that is fair and efficient and ensuring that the City provides services that the residents can see, touch, and feel. The Department’s revenue collections enable the Administration to invest in the Mayor’s strategic priorities, including housing, education, and making Philadelphia the safest, cleanest, and greenest big city in the nation with economic opportunity for everyone.

***Work-Life***

Working hours are generally 37.5 hours per week. Our team is full-time on office days.

 **Job Description**

The Continuous Improvement Director leads the Continuous Improvement pillar within the Revenue Strategic Transformation division. This role identifies, prioritizes, and delivers process improvement initiatives that increase operational efficiency, reduce waste, and improve the experience of both employees and the residents and businesses the department serves.

The CI Director brings a disciplined improvement practice to a large public organization: mapping how work actually flows, finding where it breaks down, and redesigning it in partnership with the units that own it. Success depends on facilitation, analytical rigor, and the ability to see how decisions in one part of the department create consequences in another.

The CI Director owns the improvement methodology, process mapping and redesign discipline, customer satisfaction measurement, documentation standards, and the training that builds continuous improvement capability across the department. The role leads a small team and is expected to develop that team, not simply directing its work.

The CI Director works in close partnership with the Executive Director, who provides strategic direction, and coordinates with the division's other pillars: Operations, Project Management, Change Management, and Innovation and Advanced Analytics.

***Essential Functions***

Continuous Improvement of Methodology and Execution

* Design and maintain the department's continuous improvement framework, applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis, and process redesign methods as appropriate to each initiative.
* Lead current-state process mapping across business units, documenting workflows, identifying waste, rework, and handoff failures, and designing future-state processes in partnership with the relevant unit.
* Lead improvement initiatives from intake through implementation, ensuring changes are measurable, sustainable, and owned by the business unit responsible for execution.
* Design and maintain controls and monitoring mechanisms so improvements are sustained and do not revert to prior practice.
* Apply design thinking to identify where a local improvement would create downstream burden elsewhere, and design accordingly.

2. Intake and Prioritization

* Capture improvement opportunities from business unit requests, performance data, customer feedback, staff suggestions, and strategic priorities.
* Apply a structured prioritization framework covering feasibility screening, scoring, and portfolio balancing to select initiatives that deliver the highest value relative to effort and risk.
* Operate the shared intake and routing protocol with the Project Management Office and the Innovation and Advanced Analytics unit, so that improvement requests, project requests, and pilot concepts follow one clear path.
* Maintain a portfolio tracker providing visibility into active, pipeline, and completed initiatives with documented outcomes.

3. Customer Satisfaction Measurement

* Own design, distribution, and analysis of customer satisfaction surveys, including the external survey of residents and businesses and the internal business unit survey.
* Produce and distribute monthly reports with trend analysis and actionable insight.
* Route improvement opportunities identified through customer feedback into the intake process.
* Coordinate with Communications on distribution and messaging, and with Innovation and Advanced Analytics on data integration and reporting.

4. Standards, Procedures, and Process Documentation

* Establish departmental standards for processing documentation so procedures, workflows, and operational guides are created and maintained consistently across units.
* Provide templates, frameworks, and guidance to business units documenting their own processes, with Continuous Improvement serving as the quality standard-setter.
* Maintain a central repository of documented processes accessible to leadership and business units.

5. Training, Culture, and Team Development

* Develop and deliver a continuous improvement education plan tailored to three audiences: executive leadership for strategic awareness, managers and supervisors for application skills, and frontline staff for mindset and participation.

* Identify and develop improvement champions within business units who sustain the practice beyond individual initiatives.
* Directly develop the Continuous Improvement Specialist and Project Coordinator, building their capability in process mapping, intake discipline, and initiative support.

6. Reporting and Impact Measurement

* Track and report measurable outcomes for each initiative: time saved, errors reduced, cost avoided, satisfaction improved, or other relevant metrics.
* Produce quarterly impact reports for the Executive Director documenting portfolio progress, results achieved, and lessons learned.

* Proven leadership in strategic planning, organizational development, and change management.
* Expertise in Lean Six Sigma, process mapping, and performance benchmarking.

* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

* Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

* Demonstrated command of improvement methodologies and the judgment to select the right approach for a given problem.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional improvement initiatives from intake through measurable results.

* Change management certification such as Prosci.

records.description:
**Company Description**

Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

 **Job Description**

The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.

Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**

In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:

Be Curious

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

 
**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

 
**Additional Information**

Benefits: 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

records.description:
**Job Description:**

**Plant Director**

 

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As a **Plant Director**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Leading a team of employees dedicated to making what is indispensable to empower modern life, advance human progress, and deliver a brighter future through 3M Science.
* Overseeing plant environment, health, safety, regulatory and security practices that respect our environment, meet requirements established by regulatory bodies, protect our employees, and align with company expectations.
* Leading operational excellence through conscientious management and decisive actions in environment, health, safety, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, cost, and employee relations.
* Utilizing operational financial acumen to analyze and understand the financial implications of various choices and actions, making informed decisions based on financial data to maximize profits and minimize losses.
* Understanding and applying technology platform fundamentals and principles, thinking strategically, and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for business growth and operational efficiency.
* Accelerating value creation for our customers through responsive end-to-end supply chain performance and prompt resolution to customer inquiries.
* Developing strategic plans and budgets to drive continuous and sustainable improvements through the application of disruptive technology, lean six sigma methods, and effective employee engagement programs.
* Managing inventory, and influencing supplier performance.
* Championing inclusive programs that create a great place to work for all our employees and demonstrating behavior aligned with a work environment in which employees, consultants, and contract workers know that ethical and legal behavior is always expected of them.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution.
* Ten (10) years of experience in a manufacturing or production facility in private, public, government, or military environment.
* Five (5) years of experience in a plant leadership role.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Proven experience in plant leadership roles, demonstrating the ability to drive operational excellence and achieve results.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality control, and safety standards.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate future trends, effectively prepare for change, create and communicate change action plans, and implement sustainable change.
* Strategic mindset and the ability to develop and execute plans to meet operational goals.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in physical sciences, Operations Management, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
* Experience in proven continuous improvement process improvement methodologies.

**Work location:**

* **Onsite, Tonawanda, New York**

**Travel: May include up to 10%** **domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

**Chat with Max**

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

records.title: Director of Television Strategy & Operations
records.description:
**About His Glory**

His Glory is a Christian ministry and global broadcast network dedicated to sharing the Word of God, delivering meaningful programming and reaching audiences worldwide through television, digital media, streaming platforms and original content.

**Position Overview**

As His Glory continues to expand its global television network and digital media presence, we are seeking an experienced, strategic and hands-on Director of Television Strategy & Operations to lead initiatives focused on network growth, operational excellence and long-term scalability.

This individual will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies that strengthen network performance, enhance departmental collaboration, improve operational infrastructure, expand audience reach and support the continued evolution of His Glory Television.

The ideal candidate brings extensive television and media industry experience, strong business acumen and a demonstrated ability to lead teams, develop operational systems and successfully grow a television or media organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee the overall operations and performance of the television network.
* Develop and implement strategic initiatives to support network growth, audience expansion and long-term sustainability.
* Lead, develop and hold departmental leaders accountable for performance and results.
* Oversee departmental budgets, resource allocation and operational expenses.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators across the network.
* Identify opportunities to expand programming, distribution, partnerships and revenue.
* Improve operational systems, processes and departmental workflows.
* Ensure alignment between programming, production and broadcast operations.
* Maintain high standards of professionalism, quality and organizational accountability.
* Ensure network initiatives align with His Glory's mission, vision and values.

**Qualifications & Experience Requirements**

* Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in television, broadcasting, streaming or digital media.
* Minimum of 5 years of senior leadership or management experience within the media or broadcast industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple departments and teams.
* Strong understanding of television network operations, programming, production and distribution.
* Experience with strategic planning, budgeting and performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to grow an organization, department or media platform.
* Strong business acumen, leadership and decision-making skills.
* Ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on when necessary.
* Understanding of traditional and emerging media distribution platforms.
* Commitment to supporting His Glory's Christian mission and organizational values.

**What Success Looks Like**

A well-managed, financially responsible and growing television network with strong departmental leadership, clear accountability, efficient operations and measurable results.

Pay: From $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* How many years of professional television, broadcasting or digital media experience do you have?
* Have you worked for a television network, broadcast station or professional streaming organization?
* How many years of experience do you have managing personnel?
* Please describe the largest team or department you have managed.
* Please describe a department, process or initiative you have successfully built, improved or grown.
* What interests you about working for His Glory?
* What are your salary expectations?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mount Pleasant, TX 75455

records.description:
Director of Operations – Dave’s Hot Chicken

**Position:** Director of Operations

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** Restaurant / Multi-Unit Operations

About the Role

Dave’s Hot Chicken is looking for a highly motivated, results-driven **Director of Operations** to lead and support our growing restaurant operations.

This position is responsible for driving operational excellence across multiple locations while developing strong leaders, building a high-performance culture, delivering an exceptional guest experience, and achieving financial results.

We are looking for a leader who understands that great restaurant operations start with **great people**. The Director of Operations will work closely with General Managers and restaurant leadership teams to create accountability, consistency, and a culture where team members feel supported, challenged, recognized, and given opportunities to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and oversight for multiple Dave’s Hot Chicken locations.
* Ensure restaurants consistently execute Dave’s Hot Chicken operational standards, food quality, cleanliness, hospitality, and brand expectations.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and provide clear, actionable feedback to leadership teams.
* Identify operational opportunities and develop plans to improve restaurant performance.
* Ensure restaurants are properly staffed and prepared to execute at a high level.
* Maintain strong standards for food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance.

People & Leadership Development

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing General Managers and restaurant leaders.
* Build a strong pipeline of future General Managers, Area Leaders, and other operations leaders.
* Create individualized development plans for key leaders and high-potential team members.
* Hold leaders accountable while providing the coaching, tools, and resources necessary for them to succeed.
* Recognize outstanding performance and create a culture where accomplishments are celebrated.
* Ensure leaders are actively developing their teams rather than simply managing daily operations.
* Promote a culture of respect, communication, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Financial Performance

* Take ownership of restaurant sales, profitability, labor, food cost, controllable expenses, and overall financial performance.
* Analyze P&L statements and restaurant performance reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Develop action plans to improve underperforming locations.
* Partner with restaurant leadership to increase sales while maintaining appropriate labor and cost controls.
* Establish clear performance expectations and follow up consistently on results.

Guest Experience

* Ensure every restaurant delivers a consistently outstanding guest experience.
* Monitor guest feedback and identify recurring opportunities.
* Coach restaurant leaders on hospitality, speed of service, order accuracy, food quality, and restaurant cleanliness.
* Ensure guest concerns are handled quickly, professionally, and appropriately.

New Restaurant Openings & Growth

* Support new restaurant openings, including staffing, training, leadership development, and operational readiness.
* Build leadership benches ahead of organizational growth.
* Help establish scalable systems and processes as the organization adds locations.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop strategies that support long-term growth.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

* 7+ years of progressive restaurant operations leadership experience.
* 3+ years of successful multi-unit leadership experience.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurant locations.
* Proven ability to develop General Managers and build leadership pipelines.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&L management, labor, food cost, sales building, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to improve restaurant performance and hold teams accountable for results.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication, coaching, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance **people, operations, guest experience, and profitability**.
* Willingness to travel regularly between restaurant locations.
* Must be willing to work weekend, nights and availability to travel.

The Leader We Want

We are looking for someone who:

* **Leads from the front** and is comfortable spending significant time inside the restaurants.
* Builds relationships and earns the trust of their teams.
* Sets high expectations without losing sight of the people responsible for delivering the results.
* Develops leaders instead of simply giving directions.
* Recognizes and rewards great performance.
* Communicates clearly and follows through on commitments.
* Makes decisions based on both operational data and what is actually happening inside the restaurants.
* Takes ownership and expects the same from their leadership team.
* Understands that sustainable financial performance comes from strong operations, strong leadership, and engaged teams.
* Is passionate about building a winning culture while growing the Dave’s Hot Chicken brand.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means:

**Great People. Great Restaurants. Great Guest Experiences. Strong Financial Results.**

The Director of Operations will be expected to build restaurants where team members want to work, leaders have opportunities to grow, guests want to return, and the business consistently delivers strong results.

Why Join Dave’s Hot Chicken?

This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a rapidly growing restaurant brand. You will have the ability to influence operations, develop future leaders, support restaurant growth, and help create a culture built around accountability, recognition, development, and operational excellence.

**Dave’s Hot Chicken is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

records.title: Executive Director Operations
records.description:
### **Who We Are**

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a **Human First** philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world's leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML's global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

**About Hudson Rouge**

Hudson Rouge is part of WPP | Ford, the integrated global WPP team bringing together creative, media, production, experience, technology, data, and other specialist capabilities in support of Ford Motor Company and its brands. WPP | Ford connects expertise across WPP agencies and markets to deliver coordinated solutions and a consistent client experience. Hudson Rouge brings its distinct luxury expertise and focus on Lincoln to this broader partnership. As Lincoln advances its luxury ambition and enters an important period of brand evolution, this leader will partner with the CEO of Hudson Rouge and agency senior leadership to assess the current operating environment, identify high-impact opportunities, and build the capabilities and discipline needed to deliver today while modernizing how the agency works for the future.

**The Opportunity**

Hudson Rouge, WPP's luxury boutique and the integrated agency supporting Lincoln, is seeking an Executive Director of Operations & Transformation to help shape the next chapter of the agency and its partnership with the brand. The Executive Director will connect business strategy with people, processes, systems, technology, scope, resources, and financial performance. They will diagnose barriers to effectiveness, introduce fit-for-purpose methodologies, and drive an agency-wide transformation agenda that improves efficiency, collaboration, decision-making, and accountability.

**Leadership profile**

A strategic and pragmatic business operator who is energized by building what comes next. This leader is an integrator and a change agent: collaborative, influential, comfortable with complexity, and able to bring clarity without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. They combine low ego with high accountability and understand the creativity, pace, technology, and standards required to build a modern luxury brand.

Above all, this is a hands-on change leader who can quickly assess how the agency operates, challenge established practices constructively, and identify where changes to processes, systems, organizational capabilities, and ways of working will create meaningful improvements. They bring fresh methodologies, turn opportunities into practical plans, and mobilize leaders across the agency to deliver measurable, lasting change.

As a key member of the Hudson Rouge leadership team, this individual will set a clear transformation roadmap, establish timelines and decision points, and create shared accountability for execution across agency leadership and throughout the organization.

**Key responsibilities**

**Lead the operating model**

* Partner with leadership to evolve the operating model for Hudson Rouge and its partnership with the broader WPPecosystem.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, governance, and leadership operating rhythms.
* Translate business priorities and diagnostic findings into actionable organizational goals, improvement initiatives, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Assess and redesign processes, systems, governance, meetings, reporting, and ways of working to eliminate friction and improve quality, speed, and effectiveness.
* Balance the agency's boutique, entrepreneurial culture with the structure required to support a complex, integrated business.

**Reimagine the agency through AI and technology**

* Partner with capability leads to define Hudson Rouge's AI priorities and roadmap, identifying where AI can have the greatest impact on how the agency operates and delivers for Lincoln.
* Translate Hudson Rouge's business, client, and operational needs into clear opportunities and requirements for the central AI team.
* Partner closely with the central AI team, which will lead AI strategy, solution design, governance, and implementation.
* Coordinate adoption across Hudson Rouge, ensuring leaders and teams are prepared to incorporate new AI-enabled ways of working into their day-to-day operations.

**Drive transformation**

* Partner with the CEO of Hudson Rouge and leadership team to diagnose operational gaps, prioritize opportunities, and collectively own a focused, agency-wide transformation agenda.
* Build and manage a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear workstreams, accountable leaders, milestones, timelines, success measures, and regular progress reviews.
* Lead change management from leadership alignment through agency-wide adoption, equipping teams with the tools, communication, and support to sustain new ways of working.
* Track progress and measurable business impact, surface risks and missed commitments, and hold leadership accountable for course correction and delivery.

**Lead Project Management and delivery excellence**

* Provide leadership and direction for Project Management as a core agency discipline.
* Partner with the Head of Project Management to define the PM model, standards, talent expectations, tools, and measures of effectiveness.
* Ensure portfolio visibility supports leadership decisions around priorities, resources, dependencies, timing, and risk.
* Strengthen connections across Project Management, Account, Creative, Strategy, Production, Finance, and specialist capabilities.
* Position Project Management as a strategic business and delivery partner, with the Head of PM accountable for day-to-day PM leadership and execution.

**Integrate business, scope, resources, and performance**

* Connect client priorities, scope, staffing, resources, financial performance, and delivery into a cohesive operating view.
* Establish effective operating reviews around business performance, scope, staffing, investment, and organizational priorities.
* Help leadership evaluate trade-offs involving priorities, resources, timing, and investment.
* Support annual scope and staffing planning by connecting client ambition with the capabilities and capacity required to deliver it.

**Strengthen integration across Hudson Rouge and WPP**

* Build stronger connections across Hudson Rouge and the WPP capabilities supporting Lincoln.
* Establish clear ownership, governance, and ways of working across functions and specialist partners.
* Create greater continuity across strategy, creative, production, media, experience, CRM, analytics, social, PR, retail, and other disciplines.
* Help create an experience in which the client and internal teams operate as one connected Lincoln partnership.

**Experience and capabilities**

The ideal candidate will bring:

* Leadership experience in agency operations, business transformation, consulting, or a similarly complex client-service organization.
* Proven record as a change agent: diagnosing organizational opportunities, redesigning operating models, and leading complex, measurable transformation through implementation and adoption.
* Experience introducing new operating methodologies and translating recommendations into practical roadmaps, timelines, governance, and sustained results.
* A strong point of view on how AI, technology, data, and automation can reshape creative and client-service organizations.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and transformation across functions, locations, or organizational entities.
* Experience leading or partnering closely with strong Project Management or integrated-delivery capabilities.
* Strong understanding of agency economics, scope, staffing, resource planning, and commercial management.
* The ability to connect organizational, operational, financial, technology, and client considerations.
* Strong executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to challenge constructively, align senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across organizational boundaries.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and decision-framing skills.
* Automotive, luxury, or complex integrated-account experience is preferred.

**Reporting and relationships**

The Executive Director, Operations & Transformation will report to the Head of Hudson Rouge and work closely with the Hudson Rouge leadership team and the WPP | Ford COO and Operations team. Project Management will report into this role, with the Head of Project Management responsible for the PM team, project management standards, portfolio visibility, and delivery discipline.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

records.description:
**A Top Workplace**

At PT Solutions, we’re more than colleagues; we’re a tight-knit community united in our mission to expand access to quality care. Our commitment to you is evident in our industry-leading professional development opportunities. From ongoing evidence-based clinical education to dedicated mentorship opportunities and an APTA-accredited Orthopedic Residency Program, we propel our clinicians toward excellence in physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, and athletic training.

PT Solutions has been named a 2026 USA Today Top Workplace for the fifth consecutive year, based entirely on employee feedback. We’ve also earned five Culture Excellence Awards for Innovation, Professional Development, Work-Life Flexibility, Appreciation, and Purpose & Values. This recognition reflects a culture built around supporting our people. It’s not just what we do, but how we make people feel. Through human connection, intentional care, and being all in for one another, we create experiences that make a difference. Because together, we do great better.

Let’s go further together and transform care.Join the #PTSLife today! To see what #PTSLife is like, visit Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified candidates to apply!

The District Director of (Hospital) Operations is responsible for driving operational precision and efficiency across a defined geographic district of hospitals. This role focuses on optimizing patient flow, reducing length of stay (LOS), and improving care transitions to enhance both patient outcomes and financial sustainability. The district director will implement standardized best practices, leverage data-driven insights, and collaborate with site leaders and key hospital partners to ensure seamless, high-quality, and cost-effective hospital operations.

**Essential Functions**

**Operational Precision and Standardization**

* Implement practice-wide operational strategies to enhance patient throughput, capacity management, and resource utilization

records.title: Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence
records.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

The Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence will lead a new enterprise team that brings inventory back to plan and keeps it there. The role installs a standard inventory management system at Teledyne sites: control of the material coming in, sound stocking policy and planning, and regular reviews that turn data into decisions. The Director leads the program and works hands-on at one site at a time, starting in our defense businesses.

A key part of this role involves partnering with Segment leadership, site General Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to set standard work, build site capability, and deliver sustainable business results, supporting enterprise objectives for working capital, on-time delivery, and margin.

**This role requires up to 75% travel. Due to the extensive travel involved, candidates may be based anywhere within the United States.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead standard site assessments of planning maturity, part-level inventory, and forecast accuracy, and partner with site leadership to prioritize and execute improvement opportunities.
* Set and deploy baseline standard work for every site, including weekly action on MRP messages for open purchase orders, receiving to plan, monthly inventory forecast reporting, and documented decisions on excess, obsolete, and aged WIP inventory.
* Drive inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives across the organization. Lead tactical controls on open purchase orders and receipts first, then structural fixes to safety stock, min/max settings, inventory entitlement, and planning.
* Own the guiding metric: material and labor going into inventory vs. cost of goods shipped, tracked monthly and forecast a year ahead, so sites act before inventory builds.
* Establish and implement enterprise inventory policies, standards, and governance, including decision rights for buying ahead of demand, keeping excess, and disposing of obsolete material.
* Run the monthly enterprise inventory review with senior leadership, using KPI dashboards to monitor every site, identify gaps, and drive accountability.
* Co-lead each site’s weekly material exception review and monthly General Manager inventory review, then coach site leaders to run them on their own.
* Strengthen SIOP, demand forecasting, and make-to-stock or make-to-order decisions with site planning teams, from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.
* Leverage AI-enabled technologies, automation, and advanced analytics to improve inventory decisions, reporting, and business performance.
* Capture what works at each site in a standard playbook and share best practices across the enterprise.
* Lead and develop a team of one Manager and two Inventory Analysts working two sites at a time.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Materials Management, or Operational Excellence, including site-level operations or supply chain leadership.
* APICS CPIM or CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing and global business environments.
* Ability to travel up to 75%, including extended on-site periods during site engagements, to work with site teams, run operational reviews, and develop site leaders across Teledyne business units.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives and deliver measurable inventory and working capital results.
* Deep knowledge of materials management and supply chain planning, including MRP, open purchase order management, safety stock and inventory policy, SIOP, and demand forecasting.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Standard Work, and Root Cause Problem Solving.
* Experience deploying and sustaining business systems or enterprise operating models across multiple sites or business units, with hands-on factory and supply chain experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Passion for continuous improvement, emerging technologies, AI-enabled business transformation, and operational excellence.

* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills, including leading site teams without direct authority.
* Experience utilizing KPI dashboards, operational scorecards, and performance management systems.
* Experience working in ERP systems (SAP preferred) and across multiple ERP environments.

**Due to the type of work performed and facility access requirements, applicants must be a "U.S. Person" (U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee).**

**Salary Range:**

$136,700.00-$182,300.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.
