**Director of Quality**
=======================

**Colorado Springs, CO | Full-Time | On-Site**

### **Lead Quality. Develop People. Protect the Mission.**

At Cogitic Corporation, quality isn't just a department, it's critical to our mission. We manufacture precision components supporting the U.S. Navy and national defense programs, where accuracy, accountability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

We're seeking an experienced, technically strong Director of Quality to lead our Quality Management System (QMS), develop our inspection team, and drive a culture of operational excellence.

**This is not a desk-only leadership position.** We're looking for someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and remain technically engaged. The right person is just as comfortable leading an audit or developing a quality strategy as they are reviewing a complex drawing, troubleshooting an inspection challenge, or supporting CMM programming.

If you're a quality leader who takes ownership, develops people, and believes in getting things right the first time, we want to hear from you.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Quality Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality and Inspection team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
* Build a high-performing team that values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving.
* Balance strategic quality initiatives with daily operational priorities to support production and delivery commitments.

**Quality Management & Compliance**

* Own, maintain, and continuously improve Cogitic's QMS, ensuring compliance with applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
* Lead internal, customer, supplier, and external audits, ensuring findings are addressed effectively and on time.
* Drive corrective action efforts, including root-cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and verification of effectiveness.
* Ensure quality processes support traceability, documentation accuracy, product conformance, and audit readiness.

**Technical Quality & Inspection**

* Oversee inspection planning, testing, and product acceptance for complex, precision-machined components.
* Apply advanced knowledge of engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and dimensional inspection methods.
* Provide hands-on technical support with inspection processes, CMM programming, measurement techniques, and complex quality challenges.
* Maintain oversight of measurement and test equipment (M&TE), calibration programs, and inspection equipment readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve inspection efficiency, accuracy, and first-pass quality.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Mission Assurance, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns and execute customer requirements.
* Lead supplier quality activities, including qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and compliance with flow-down requirements.
* Establish and monitor meaningful quality KPIs to identify trends, reduce defects, and drive measurable improvements.
* Leverage ProShop ERP, quality data, and standard quality tools to strengthen processes, reporting, and operational visibility.
* Promote a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, and doing things right the first time.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Welding Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing quality experience, including hands-on machining, inspection, or precision manufacturing exposure.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing technical quality or inspection personnel.
* Strong understanding of AS9100 quality management systems, audit processes, corrective actions, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Advanced ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and dimensional tolerances.
* Proven ability to investigate quality issues, identify root causes, implement sustainable solutions, and hold teams accountable.
* Strong technical aptitude, analytical judgment, communication skills, and ability to balance competing priorities.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Office, and technical quality software.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to successfully complete required background screening and meet applicable security clearance eligibility requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting U.S. Navy, NAVSEA, nuclear, or other highly regulated defense manufacturing programs.
* Hands-on experience with CMM programming, inspection planning, and precision measurement equipment.
* Experience managing calibration and M&TE programs.
* Working knowledge of ProShop ERP and SolidWorks or similar CAD software.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), ASME GD&T certification, or comparable credentials.
* Experience with supplier quality management, customer audits, and complex contractual quality requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

In this role, success means more than passing audits. You'll be expected to:

* Build a capable, accountable Quality team that operates with confidence and consistency.
* Maintain an effective, audit-ready QMS that supports the business rather than slowing it down.
* Reduce recurring quality issues through effective root-cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.
* Improve inspection efficiency, product conformance, and on-time execution.
* Develop stronger cross-functional partnerships and establish clear ownership of quality throughout the organization.

**Who Thrives at Cogitic?**
---------------------------

Our strongest leaders demonstrate our core values of **Performance, Character, Courage, Development, and Initiative.**

We're looking for someone who takes ownership instead of assigning blame, addresses challenges directly, coaches rather than simply directs, and understands that quality and operational performance must work together.

You should be comfortable in a growing organization where priorities evolve, expectations are high, and your leadership can make a meaningful impact.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

**Compensation:** $150k - 200K annually, based on experience and qualifications.

At Cogitic, we believe in taking care of our team and providing opportunities to grow. Our benefits include:

* **Medical Insurance:** Competitive medical coverage with employer contributions toward premiums.
* **Dental Insurance:** Employer contributes 20% toward dental premiums.
* **Vision Insurance:** Voluntary vision coverage.

* **Life Insurance:** Employer-paid basic life and AD&D coverage.
* **Additional Coverage:** Voluntary life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability options.
* **Paid Time Off:** PTO and 10 company-observed holidays.
* **Professional Development:** Opportunities for continued learning, technical development, and leadership growth.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**
----------------------------

If you're an experienced quality leader who enjoys building strong teams, solving complex manufacturing challenges, and supporting work that matters, we'd love to connect.

**Apply today and help shape the future of Quality at Cogitic Corporation.**

records.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Technical Operations, you’ll own manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations. We build hundreds of robots a year today and need to build a lot more. You’ll own how we get there, including the teams, suppliers and facilities, and work closely with engineering along the way.

You’ll report to the CTO. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Scaling production from hundreds of robots a year to many more
* Manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations
* The teams, suppliers and facilities behind production
* A close partnership with engineering

**Requirements**
----------------

* Ran manufacturing or operations at a company that builds complex hardware in volume
* Built an operations function and hired the people who run it
* Been responsible for a fleet of products in the field, including service and support
* Sets clear targets and hires well
* Comfortable on a factory floor

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, or other products that combine hardware and software
* Experience with contract manufacturers
* Experience with quality systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

This role leads manufacturing engineering, industrialization, tooling, test systems, automation, and technical production support for our systems products, with a strong emphasis on configure-to-order assembly manufacturing. Working closely with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, the Senior Manager will establish clear priorities, strengthen new product and production transfer readiness, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and equipment reliability.

**Be one of the Bedo 100**
--------------------------

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to enable every satellite mission to enter this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo's trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you're advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on Earth.

**How We Operate:** Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

**Who We're Looking For:** Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You'll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn't feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Own Albedo's production operations across Supply Chain, Assembly, Integration & Test (AI&T), and Facilities, ensuring flight hardware is delivered on schedule, within budget, and to quality requirements.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians, test personnel, and supply chain professionals, including hiring, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Develop and execute integrated production plans, aligning material readiness, build schedules, staffing, and test capacity across vehicle and subsystem builds.
* Set supply chain strategy and priorities, ensuring sourcing, supplier development, procurement, and long-lead planning stay ahead of production demand.

* Lead facilities and production infrastructure planning, including buildout, commissioning, equipment, capacity expansion, and EHS.
* Establish and track operational metrics, including supplier delivery, material readiness, schedule adherence, labor efficiency, throughput, and first-pass yield.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Operations
records.description:
Location: On-site – Alachua, Florida (Greater Gainesville Metropolitan Area)  
Department: Quality Assurance  
Reports To: Head of Global Quality  
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

### **About Ascend Advanced Therapies**

Ascend Advanced Therapies is a biotechnology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of advanced therapies, with a focus on adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies. Our team is committed to advancing innovative treatments through scientific expertise, operational excellence, and a strong culture of quality and compliance.

#### **About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Operations to join our team at our Alachua, Florida facility.

In this leadership role, you will oversee Quality Assurance activities supporting GMP manufacturing, Quality Control, warehouse, facilities, and related operations. You will provide strategic oversight of quality processes, ensure regulatory compliance and inspection readiness, and drive continuous improvement across site operations.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive Quality Assurance experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, demonstrated people leadership capabilities, and strong knowledge of GMP requirements, investigations, CAPAs, change control, and quality risk management.

This is a full-time, on-site leadership opportunity for an experienced quality professional who is passionate about developing high-performing teams, strengthening operational excellence, and supporting the advancement of innovative therapies.

#### **Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Lead Quality Assurance support for GMP manufacturing, Quality Control, warehouse, facilities, and support operations.
* Establish departmental priorities and ensure quality activities support production schedules, client commitments, and regulatory requirements.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Provide strategic oversight of batch record review, room release, on-floor QA activities, manufacturing investigations, and product disposition support.
* Ensure appropriate QA oversight of Quality Control operations, including analytical data review, laboratory investigations, Environmental Monitoring, and data integrity compliance.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant manufacturing and laboratory compliance issues.
* Oversee investigations, deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality risk management activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and compliance trends to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure inspection readiness through effective management of quality systems and compliance programs.
* Lead Quality participation during regulatory inspections, client audits, and corporate audits.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative during client interactions and compliance-related discussions.
* Review and approve responses to audit observations and regulatory commitments.
* Directly supervise and develop Quality Assurance personnel, including Senior Quality Operations Specialists.
* Establish performance objectives, provide coaching, and support employee development.
* Build team capability through mentoring, training, and succession planning.
* Provide independent, risk-based quality leadership across site operations.
* Balance business objectives with regulatory compliance requirements.
* Drive resolution of complex quality and compliance challenges.
* Influence cross-functional decision-making through technical expertise and sound judgment.
* Escalate significant compliance risks to senior leadership as appropriate.

#### **Educational Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 8-10 years of Quality Assurance experience within biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, vaccine, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Minimum 3 years of progressive people leadership and supervisory experience, including performance management, employee development, talent management, succession planning, and employee engagement.
* Demonstrated experience supporting GMP manufacturing and Quality Control operations.
* Experience managing investigations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality risk assessments.
* Experience participating in or hosting FDA, client, and regulatory inspections.
* Strong technical knowledge of:

* + 21 CFR Parts 210, 211, 600, and 610
  + EU GMP Volume 4
  + Annex 1
  + ICH Q7, Q9, and Q10
  + FDA Data Integrity Guidance
  + FDA Process Validation Guidance
* Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects/tasks at one time, as well as management of program interdependencies to meet set timelines.

Preferred:

* Commercial biologics manufacturing experience.
* CDMO experience supporting multiple client programs.
* Experience supporting technology transfer and process validation activities.
* ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
* Experience utilizing electronic Quality Management Systems (MasterControl, Veeva, TrackWise, or equivalent).

#### **Physical Requirements**

This position requires the ability to perform duties in a combination of office and GMP-regulated manufacturing environments. Physical activities may include prolonged sitting or standing, walking throughout manufacturing and laboratory areas, reaching, bending, and performing repetitive motions associated with computer work and documentation review.

The role requires manual dexterity for typing and handling documents and materials, as well as visual acuity sufficient to review records, analyze data, read equipment labels, and distinguish colors.

Occasional lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling of materials may be required as appropriate to the position.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

#### **Travel Requirements**

Approximately 10%.

#### **Supervisory Responsibilities**

This position has direct supervisory responsibilities for Quality Assurance personnel, including performance management, coaching, employee development, and succession planning.

A minimum of three years of progressive people leadership and supervisory experience is required.

**Job Description:**

The **Senior Manager of Quality** will be responsible for leading all aspects of Quality Assurance throughout the product development lifecycle for L3Harris’ Culpeper, VA site. This position will have responsibility for direct supervision and leadership of ~60 quality personnel. The Sr. Manager will be responsible for driving continual process and product improvement ensuring product and process integrity, leading to customer satisfaction and overall mission success while supporting division quality, delivery and cost targets. This position will lead quality personnel and collaborate frequently with Program leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing and Supply Chain personnel. This is a hands-on, highly involved leadership position. Ability to obtain a Secret clearance is required for this position.

**Essential Functions:**

  

* Responsible for the Quality Engineering and Inspection functions, supporting all business practices, including quality planning, compliance monitoring and validation for programs, hardware, software and inspection.
* Responsibility for resolving technical challenges, ensuring successful tactical execution, as well as creating and implementing the strategic vision for the Quality department.
* Develop and implement strategic Quality initiatives and programs in support of the site promoting sound and effective principles as set forth in company procedures, government standards and directives, and commercially proven methodology and ensure that the department conforms to these principles.
* Promote a strong culture of quality focused on every employee engaged and enhancing the customer experience through rigorous attention to detail and prevention of defects.
* Work closely with the program teams and the functional organizations to ensure that all phases of the product life cycle, from early customer involvement through post-delivery support, meet the requirements for mission success.
* Ensure that manufacturing engineering, operations and design engineering interact sufficiently throughout the product planning and design phases to ensure a seamless hand-off during product transition to production including design reviews and facilitating quality concurrent Engineering.
* Responsible for the maintenance of quality records that document the quality status of material/products and provide necessary information and cumulative data for internal and external Customer responses.
* Develop, review and verify compliance of all Work Package Descriptions issued for Quality tasks for proposals and ongoing contracts/projects.
* Improve the efficiency of the Quality organization through effective leadership, individual and group training, and process improvement.
* Collect and analyze key quality measures such as Cost of Poor Quality to develop zero defect plans, improve yields and reduce rework during engineering and manufacturing efforts. Report to senior leadership on business performance including action plans to improve business execution and status of strategic initiatives.
* Maintain certification and compliance efforts for AS9100 and other required certifications.

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 years of prior related Quality Management experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior related experience.

* In depth knowledge of quality and reliability methods and procedures for hardware and software systems as they apply to the aerospace or electronic industry.
* Greenbelt or Blackbelt certification and/or proven education or work history in leading and implementing projects.
* Experience with Configuration Control management practices.
* ASQ certification preferred; Experience managing AS9100 certified business.

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills including communications, facilitation, consulting, coaching, and influencing.
* Self-motivated and possess demonstrated ability to motivate others to achieve timely results.
* Highly collaborative style, capable of working across multiple functional areas to drive results.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
***Ready to lead a function, not just a shift? This is your next step.***

American Armor Gloves makes high-quality nitrile gloves here at home in South Carolina. Healthcare workers, first responders, and essential workers across the country rely on what we build. Our purpose is simple: **We strengthen America by building quality protection at home.**

We're a lean, growing manufacturer scaling toward 320–350 people, and we've spent the past year building the foundation for that growth: a redesigned organization, a clear vision with quarterly milestones, defined leadership roles, and a new leadership and compensation architecture. Manufacturing is the heart of that growth, and we need a leader ready to own it.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

The Director of Manufacturing is one of the most essential roles in our company. You'll own the end-to-end performance of our Manufacturing department, turning business plans into consistent, safe, high-quality production results.

This role is built for an accomplished Manufacturing Manager who is ready to take the next step. You've proven you can run a strong operation. Now you're ready to **lead through systems and leaders rather than personal effort on the floor**, and to build a manufacturing function that performs at a high level no matter which team is on shift.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, you'll be the bridge between enterprise strategy and shift-by-shift execution. You'll set the systems, build the leaders, and own the results.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own manufacturing performance.** Deliver results across safety, quality, OEE, throughput, schedule attainment, labor productivity, scrap, and downtime through accountable leaders and strong systems.

* **Build repeatable production systems.** Design shift handoffs, accountability routines, labor deployment standards, and scheduling so performance never depends on heroics.

* **Lead and develop your Shift Manager team.** Coach your Shift Managers as leaders, not only as production operators, and build the next generation of manufacturing leadership.

* **Integrate compounding and batching.** Keep material availability, formulation compliance, and production demand aligned and well governed.

* **Drive continuous improvement.** Lead projects that reduce waste, improve workflow, raise OEE, and close performance gaps, in partnership with Process Engineering.

* **Partner across the business.** Work side by side with Quality, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, and People & Culture to remove barriers to production.

* **Build workforce capability.** Own training plans, manufacturing career pathways, and engagement so our workforce is ready to support growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

You'll set daily and weekly production priorities, deploy labor across shifts, manage Shift Manager performance, and direct improvement projects within manufacturing. You'll shape manufacturing KPI targets, capacity planning, equipment needs, and staffing structure through your recommendations to the VP of Operations. You'll lead Shift Managers, Production Planning, and Batching/Compounding leadership, with a frontline team of Production Supervisors and Manufacturing Associates across multiple shifts.

**A REAL CAREER PATHWAY**

We grow leaders deliberately, and this role is designed as a launch point, not a ceiling. Our leadership framework defines exactly what it takes to grow from functional leadership into executive leadership, and we invest in getting high performers there.

* **Where you go next.** The Director of Manufacturing is a direct pathway to VP of Operations or other senior operations leadership, based on demonstrated enterprise judgment, cross-functional partnership, and the strength of the leadership bench you build.

* **How you get there.** Expect direct mentoring from the VP of Operations, exposure to enterprise planning and capital decisions, cross-functional visibility, and formal leadership development.

* **A clear standard.** Your growth is measured against the same competency framework used for job descriptions, performance reviews, and succession planning, so you always know where you stand and what comes next.

* **Visibility at the top.** Our annual bench-strength review puts strong leaders on the executive team’s radar early.

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

* **Essential to the mission.** Every glove we ship runs through the function you lead.

* **Build, not just run.** Our organization is lean and still forming, so you'll shape systems and standards that scale with the business.

* **A clear operating rhythm.** A shared vision, quarterly milestones, and a common scorecard keep leaders aligned and connect your work to company priorities.

* **Leave a legacy.** You'll develop Shift Managers into future Directors and Supervisors into future Shift Managers, building a team that carries the company forward.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Industrial Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent progressive leadership experience

* 8–10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership in a high-volume environment

* Proven success leading multiple shifts and developing frontline leaders

* A track record of owning department performance through KPIs, systems, and accountable leadership

* Strong cross-functional partnership with Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and HR

* Solid knowledge of OSHA safety requirements and manufacturing quality systems

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, ERP/MRP systems (NetSuite preferred), KPI dashboards, production scheduling, and QMS

**Bonus points for:** experience in medical device, PPE, chemical processing, or FDA-regulated manufacturing; Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement practice; ERP implementation; and leading through growth and scale.

**HOW YOU LEAD**

You lead safely, every shift, not only when incidents happen. You hold leaders accountable through systems, not by stepping in for them. When something breaks, you fix the system, not just the shift. You raise problems early and directly. You treat Quality, Engineering, and Maintenance as partners, and you understand how manufacturing affects the entire business.

**READY FOR YOUR NEXT STEP?**

If you're a Manufacturing Manager ready to own a function, build leaders, and grow into enterprise leadership with a company that's scaling with purpose, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today.

records.title: Director, Protein Operations
records.description:
Twist Bioscience is seeking a Director, Protein Operations to lead high-throughput protein production and characterization within our Operations organization. You will run a high-throughput operation that runs seven days a week and lead a large, multi-level team that delivers purified, well-characterized antibodies and proteins to internal programs and external customers on time, at quality, and at cost. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in protein expression, purification, and characterization with the rigor to scale a production organization and the drive to automate it.

**Leadership and Operations**

* Lead a large protein production and characterization organization that operates seven days a week, including managers, supervisors, scientists, and associates.
* Own key performance indicators (KPIs) for quality, on-time delivery, turnaround time (TAT), capacity, and cost of goods sold (COGS), and model capacity and staffing against demand.
* Drive continuous process improvement and lead complex investigations, including customer incidents.
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, and training in line with ISO 13485 and other regulatory requirements.

**Protein Production**

* Oversee high-throughput antibody production in HEK293, CHO, and cell-free systems across IgG, Fab, scFv, VHH, and bispecific formats.
* Lead downstream purification of diverse biologics, including bispecific and engineered antibodies.
* Transfer new products and processes from R&D into production and support new product introductions (NPI).

**Protein and Antibody Characterization**

* Oversee Twist's binding, developability, and cell-based functional assay suite, from assay development through execution, analysis, and data reporting, with turnaround times as fast as 1–5 business days.
* Lead binding assessment, including flow cytometry on native antigen, single-point and full kinetics/affinity (KD) by SPR and BLI, and epitope binning by SPR and BLI.
* Lead developability profiling, including analytical size-exclusion chromatography (aSEC), thermostability (nanoDSF), size distribution (DLS), polyspecificity (BVP ELISA, ovalbumin off-target), self-interaction (AC-SINS), and hydrophobic interaction screening.
* Deliver high-quality, consistent datasets that support customer lead selection and AI/ML model training.

**Automation and Scale**

* Partner with Engineering to bring a high level of automation to production and characterization, translating workflows into requirements for liquid handling, robotics, scheduling, and data systems.
* Drive walk-away, high-throughput workflows integrated with LIMS, MES, and SAP to increase capacity, reduce turnaround time, and improve reproducibility.

**Collaboration**

* Partner with R&D, Process Development, Supply Chain, QC, QA, Project Management, and Customer Support to grow the portfolio and meet customer commitments.
* Shape technology and product direction with senior leadership while staying current on antibody discovery, protein expression, and lab automation.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* PhD in protein biochemistry, biological chemistry, immunology, or a related field with 8+ years of experience in biotech, biopharma, or life science tools; or a BS/MS with 12+ years of equivalent experience.
* Experience managing managers and leading large teams, with strong coaching and people development skills.
* A proven track record of scaling protein or antibody production workflows and commercial products.
* Hands-on expertise in mammalian expression, purification (e.g., ÄKTA), and antibody characterization, including SPR/BLI kinetics and epitope binning, flow cytometry, and developability assays (aSEC, nanoDSF, DLS, AC-SINS, polyspecificity).
* Success partnering with engineering teams to implement automated, high-throughput lab workflows.
* Experience owning budgets, KPIs, and capacity planning, with working knowledge of ISO 13485/GMP, Lean, and Six Sigma.
* A strategic thinker who executes tactically, prioritizes well, and influences senior leadership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience running a high-throughput, made-to-order production operation in the life sciences.
* Experience manufacturing and purifying engineered antibodies.
* Experience with antibody characterization platforms such as Carterra and Octet.
* Familiarity with LIMS, MES, and ERP/SAP systems.

**About Twist Bioscience**

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as "writing" DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care,agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

Your Contribution
=================

The Head of Plant Production Engineering is responsible for leading all Production Engineering activities associated with customer projects, product acquisitions, new product launches, industrialization, and production readiness within the plant. This position serves as the plant's primary owner for Production Engineering processes, ensuring successful execution of the Product Development Process (PDP) from acquisition through Start of Production (SOP) and ramp-up. The role provides leadership to Production Engineers, drives standardization and deployment of manufacturing concepts, ensures manufacturability of product designs, manages capital investments, and represents Operations within project core teams. The Plant Head of Production Engineering ensures project launches meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance objectives.

* Lead, develop, coach, & manage the plant Production Engineering organization.
* Build organizational capability to support current and future product launches.
* Own industrialization activities for all customer projects within the plant. Ensure successful execution of product launches from acquisition and business transfer through SOP and stabilization.
* Lead development of manufacturing concepts, production processes, line layouts, and assembly strategies.
* Ensure product designs are manufacturable and meet operational standards.
* Coordinate launch readiness across Manufacturing Engineering, Tooling Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Purchasing, and Operations Support acquisition reviews and participate in PAC, PRC, and pre-development activities.
* Ensure implementation of Design-for-Manufacturing principles throughout project development. Ensure compliance with MAHLE PDP milestones, gates, deliverables, and timing requirements. Oversee completion of all Production Engineering deliverables throughout all quality gates.
* Monitor project status, risks, cost performance, capacity requirements, and launch readiness. Lead escalation activities when project risks threaten timing, quality, or cost objectives. Review project dashboards and launch metrics with plant leadership and program teams.
* Approve and govern: Manufacturing concepts, Process flows, Plant layouts, Assembly concepts, Material flow strategies, Value stream integration.
* Ensure application of Lean Manufacturing and Manufacturing Optimization Process (MOP) methodologies in alignment with Operations Excellence Manager.

Support flawless launch activities and manufacturing risk reduction. Lead readiness reviews for installation checks, internal process approval, internal run at rate, customer run at rate, PPAP readiness. The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.

records.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
  
  
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
  
  
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.

**Summit Polymers is a leading, global supplier of automotive interior systems including consoles, door panels, and instrument panels. With over 50 years serving the industry, we deliver engineering and product excellence to our customers, on time, in budget, with the latest innovations.**
JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)
+ Assists in developing internal performance metrics that support successful customer scorecard results

* Interfaces with key customer personnel & engages customer quality events

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations
* Expertise in major automotive OEM quality systems; Ford Q1, GM BIQS, FCA, Nissan, VW, BMW, and Toyota
* Expert problem solving skills utilizing root cause based methods; Practical Problem Solving (PPS), 8D, and 5 why methodology
* Must be able to gather and analyze information easily and make appropriate decisions.
* Outstanding leadership, team building, coaching and decision making abilities
* Highly energetic, confident, and assertive with the ability to lead and motivate others
* Must have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* A minimum score of 50 on the Wonderlic Select Assessment (Traditional score of 28 on the cognitive portion).

**Travel Requirements**
This position typically does require approximately 18 weeks per year of travel to Summit Polymers Manufacturing Sites.
  
  
**DISCLAIMER**
The information contained in this job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Agreement to complete all post-hire required training.

Votaw Precision Technologies is a trusted leader in the manufacturing of complex precision components, assemblies, and systems for the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors. With a strong reputation for technical excellence, quality craftsmanship, and on-time delivery, Votaw supports some of the world’s most demanding programs through its advanced manufacturing capabilities. The company specializes in precision machining, fabrication, welding, and complex assembly operations for mission-critical applications. Votaw Precision Technologies has long been a trusted partner in building mission-critical hardware for some of the most advanced aerospace and defense programs in the world. Our precision components support the International Space Station, nearly every major launch vehicle in operation, high-performance spacecraft (including classified missions), as well as next-generation fighter aircraft, bombers, submarines, radar systems, and ground vehicles.

We are seeking an experienced and highly knowledgeable Operations Director to lead the overall operations of a high-performance CNC machine shop. This individual will have full responsibility for the day-to-day management, technical excellence, production performance, staffing, scheduling, efficiency, and continuous improvement of the facility.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned machining professional with approximately 20 years of industry experience who understands metal cutting and CNC machining at a deep technical level and has progressed into a strong operational leadership role.

The Operations Director must be able to walk onto the shop floor, understand the machining challenges, evaluate processes, communicate effectively with machinists and programmers, identify inefficiencies, and make sound technical and operational decisions. The company utilizes a variety of CNC machining technologies, including 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis machining, as well as vertical milling, welding and large-scale assembly tooling.

**Essential Functions**

* Responsible for ensuring that the entire organization operates safely, efficiently, profitably, and to the highest standards of quality and technical excellence.
* Have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the CNC machine shop.

* Provide leadership and direction to machining, programming, production, quality, maintenance, and other shop personnel.
* Ensure the shop has the appropriate personnel, equipment, tooling, processes, and resources to meet customer requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for supervisors, leads, machinists, programmers, and support personnel.
* Serve as the primary operational leader and decision maker for the manufacturing facility.
* Work closely with programmers, machinists, and engineers to resolve technical machining issues.
* Evaluate machining processes and identify opportunities to improve cycle time, tool life, throughput, and quality.
* Ensure manufacturing processes are technically sound, repeatable, and scalable.

* Maintain an environment where machinists, engineers, programmers continuously improve their technical capabilities.
* Responsible for weld shop, tooling assembly, and manufacturing readiness team.

* Approximately 20 years of experience in the CNC machining/manufacturing industry.
* Previous experience as a Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Operations Manager, Plant Manager, Production Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Experience managing multiple shifts and 24/7 operations
* Knowledge of complex, tight-tolerance, or high-value machined components.
* Experience with 5-axis machining and advanced CNC manufacturing.
* Implementing Lean Manufacturing or continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of ERP/MRP and production scheduling systems.
* Managing capital equipment purchases and machine capacity planning.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, or other high-precision manufacturing environments is a plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly self-motivated and directed.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

* Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment, including walking the production floor, climbing stairs or ladders, occasionally lifting up to 25 pounds, and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

* Lead all plant operations including EHS, production, maintenance, engineering, and quality functions.

* Ensure consistent production of high-quality products that meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

* Develop/manage plant budgets (labor, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures).

records.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!
  
  
In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by
*TIME*
as a “Best Invention”,
*MIT Technology Review*
as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and
*Fast Company*
as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.
  
  
Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.
  
  
**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**
Role Description
  
  
As the Senior Manager of Assembly Manufacturing Engineering, you will serve as the primary architect of the production lifecycle, bridging the gap between research prototypes and high-volume factory operations. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers to develop and internalize robust manufacturing processes for both battery enclosures and module/pack assembly—including robotic joining, sealing, electrolyte filling, and leak testing. By owning the full equipment lifecycle, from defining detailed user requirements through to factory testing and final site commissioning, you ensure that production lines are world-class, delivering a "machine that builds the machine" with precision and technical rigor.
  
  
Strategically, your objective is to drive operational scale by ensuring products are designed specifically for ease of manufacturing and assembly during the earliest development phases. You will champion a data-driven culture that utilizes failure mode analysis and advanced root-cause investigation to reduce production risks and achieve aggressive targets for quality, output rate, and equipment uptime. By fostering collaboration between Product Design, Quality, and Supply Chain, you will manage the critical transition from initial design to full-scale production, ensuring that every process is statistically validated to guarantee long-term reliability and cost-effectiveness.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead the development and optimization of battery manufacturing processes for battery assembly manufacturing.
* Ensure highly capable processes are identified and demonstrated for our production facilities ahead of detailed equipment design.
* Oversee the design and implementation of manufacturing processes such as: manual and robotic assembly, joining, sealing, system leak testing, and quality checks to achieve optimal performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with product design team, R&D, quality, and supply chain, to translate product requirements into a battery design and manufacturing process that achieve our company targets.
* Collaborate cross functionally to develop and maintain PFMEA, process specifications, measurement systems GR&R, control plan, and quality inspection methods (incoming, outgoing, and in-process).
* Lead troubleshooting efforts to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Internalize responsibility for delivery of equipment and processes that enable the operations team to achieve factory production metrics (quality, yield, rate, and availability).
* Identify trends/correlations, and make data-driven decisions for process optimization.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience in a high-volume manufacturing organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering.
* 10 years of experience in engineering roles within battery manufacturing or a related industry, with expertise in complex assembly processes. 4+ leading technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing equipment procurement, setup, and commissioning, including a clear understanding of equipment qualification and validation protocols.
* Strong understanding of lean manufacturing principles and their application in a high-volume production environment.
* Proven track record of successfully leading cross-functional teams in the development and optimization of manufacturing processes for electrochemical systems.
* Proficiency in process engineering principles, statistical analysis, and quality management systems for process optimization and improvement.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Leadership and mentoring abilities with a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous learning and accelerated innovation through quick iteration.
* Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment is a plus.

*This opportunity is based out of Form Factory 1 – Form Energy’s 550,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility located in Weirton, WV, a commutable distance from Pittsburgh. Purpose-built for high-volume, advanced battery production, Form Factory 1 is a hub of fast-moving, collaborative work driving a new era of large-scale American energy manufacturing in the heart of the Rust Belt.*
*Relocation assistance is available.*
*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*
*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*
*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*
*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will
**never**
solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

records.description:
The Sr Manager, GCP Quality Assurance (Asset Lead) provides strategic quality oversight for assigned development programs within the Sun Pharma Global Development Organization (GDO) Branded Portfolio within Innovative Medicines. The role serves as the primary Quality asset representative to cross-functional global project teams and ensures compliance with applicable GXP regulations, company quality standards, and risk-based quality management principles across the clinical development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary Quality representative for assigned assets/programs.
* Provide quality risk assessments and strategic recommendations to asset teams.
* Represents QA on the clinical and non-clinical teams; Quality Assurance oversight ensures compliance to regulations, guidance, local laws, and applicable ISO standards, TORO, approved protocol, study plans, risk management, safety and product quality reporting requirements and use of validated systems for patient safety, investigational product quality, and data integrity.
* Plans, conducts, and reports GCP audits of clinical trial sites, CROs, vendors, laboratories, internal processes, computerized systems, and regulatory submission documentation in accordance with applicable regulations and procedures.
* Ensures that the GCP Audit schedules are created and approved by QA management; create and execute audit plans that ensure compliance to applicable regulations, guidance/ guidelines, and standard operating procedures.
* Able to travel to conduct audits onsite at vendors’ facilities, service providers, clinical trial sites, and/or internal Sun systems. Proficient to read/write/review written regulatory submission documents to ensure the content is compliant to regulatory requirements. Performs For-cause/Directed Audits when assigned.
* Supports/ Leads company inspection readiness preparations and hosts inspector onsite and via remote tools; Serves as Sponsor QA to support Clinical Site inspections, as required
* Influence clinical development decisions through quality expertise. Assess quality implications of protocol amendments, study design changes, vendor strategies, and regulatory commitments. Collaborate with Outsourcing, Non-clinical, Clinical teams and functional departments (including clinical supplies and project managers) to support the selection of vendors and service providers based on risk evaluation thru audit; manage complex organizational issues, identify and implement organizational mitigations and/or process improvements.
* Escalate significant quality risks to senior leadership. Monitors quality metrics, audit observations, CAPAs, deviations, and critical quality events to identify emerging trends and risks. Provides regular reporting to senior management and develops proactive mitigation strategies in collaboration with functional stakeholders.
* Support the implementation of procedures and quality systems used to support the GDO Sponsored trials and for audit conduct of vendors, labs, clinical trial sites, and submissions dossiers.
* Travel requirement is 20% domestic and international

**Requirements**

* BS Degree in Chemistry, Biology, or related scientific discipline; advanced degree preferred. A minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research, clinical quality assurance, or GxP-regulated environments within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or clinical research organizations.

* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and inspection readiness programs.
* Experience providing quality oversight to Phase I-IV clinical development programs.
* Strong risk-based quality management and stakeholder influencing skills; ability to communicate with technical and non-technical colleagues; experience establishing and maintaining effective relationships with leaders and peers.
* Demonstrated capability as organizational change agent. Ability to lead and participate on teams with shared responsibility for outcomes and decision-making.

records.description:
**Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA)**

  

**Discover Veranova:**

  

At Veranova, we believe people are our most important asset, and we are dedicated to building the most talented workforce in our industry. Our commitment to uncompromising focus on quality, compliance, safety, and excellence in delivery shapes everything we do. We are not just looking for skills; we are seeking innovative individuals who have a mindset open to learning and growth, and a desire to make a difference. Every role at Veranova plays a part in delivering an exceptional customer experience through ownership and integrity.

  

Veranova is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of complex active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for pharma and biotech customers. With deep technical expertise and impressive flexibility, we develop solutions and processes that support and accelerate innovation.

  

Join us on our mission to enable current and next-generation therapeutics to improve and save the lives of patients.

  

**Role Overview:**

  

The Sr Manager, QA is responsible for leading the Veranova Quality Assurance team, managing quality oversight of the manufacturing process and associated operations. This includes leading and managing multiple QA teams for batch record review, batch disposition, and on the floor QA support to ensure GMP compliance across all stages of manufacturing, as well as disposition and release of starting materials and customer facing Quality program leads for each client. The person filling this role will be responsible for the leadership, development and training of team members within their oversight as well as providing supportive leadership and strategic direction to operate with and maintain compliance to regulatory and industry quality standards. The role is expected to build strong collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive compliance and continuous improvement of GMP operations.

  

The position is 100% on site 1st shift at our Devens, MA facility.

  

**Core Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Evaluate and implement systems, methods, techniques, and solutions to complex quality compliance issues.
  
* Interface with Clients for project planning, and problem resolution with a strong customer service approach.
  
* Lead or support implementation of critical compliance systems and provide recommendations to operations management.
  
* Recommends the stop of any manufacture and/or distribution of a product if necessary.
  
* Manages the review, approval, and ensures delivery of Quality Assurance related training content and programs including new Quality Assurance initiatives for continuous improvement.
  
* Analyzes trends associated with data, proficiency testing, equipment/supply/reagent defects and supports development of solutions as appropriate.
  
* Direct and advise the Quality Assurance group to achieve long and short-term goals and objectives.
  
* Develops, improves, and revises Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Quality Policies as required/needed.
  
* Ensures the review and approval of equipment qualification protocols and results.
  
* Participates in internal auditing programs to assure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards.
  
* Partner collaboratively with Production, Maintenance, and QC for all Quality decisions within the scope of the role.
  
* Additional assignments/ duties to support team objective and contribute to the Veranova mission may evolve based on business needs.
  

  

**Qualifications:**

  

  
* BS or MS in Chemistry, Engineering or related field required.
  
* Must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance in an FDA regulated industry. Experience in an API in GMP environment is preferred.
  
* Minimum of 7 years of supervisory experience required; Proven ability to lead and coach, and motivate employees, clearly communicate job requirements, and effectively manage performance of staff.
  
* Must have established experience in Analytical and Quality Control support of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API).
  
* Knowledge and previous experience with GMP, ICH Q7, and 21 CFR Part 11; Expertise in FDA regulations, GMPs, and Quality Systems relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing.
  
* Experience with hosting and/or regulatory facing inspection responsibilities is required.
  
* Knowledge of Inventory Management, LIMS, Quality Management software systems experience desired.
  
* Must be a change agent and have strong interest in succession planning and professional development of their team(s); Ability to change priorities in response to company demands while continuing to deliver exceptional work quality through leadership by example.
